talents.name: Against All Odds
talents.description: For each combat tag you have on your character, increase your damage by 2% (max of 14%).

info.text: Works in PvE combat, with each mob counting as an individual combat tag.

talents.name: Emergency Reserves
talents.description: When you get hit below 20% health, gain 20% tempo immediately.

info.text: Grants 20% of your maximum Tempo on proc.
3 minute cooldown.
While under the 20% maximum health threshold, this Talent will proc every time you get hit. If it is already on cooldown, the cooldown will be refreshed and nothing else will happen.

talents.name: Unswayed
talents.description: The effects of Taunt and Encore no longer work on you.

info.text: The Taunt Mantra, and the Cornered Fool Talent can no longer inflict Taunt on the user.
The Sing Mantra can no longer proc the Encore Talent on the user, nullifying the stun effect.
Sing can still apply Charm and Overcharm to the user.

talents.name: Kick Off
talents.description: You easily brush off shorter falls, taking no damage. Your first wall jump will always send you higher than normal. Gain a speed boost after wall jumping over a wall.

info.text: Causes all falls to be considered 10 studs "shorter" by 10 studs, reducing the damage taken from larger falls and negating smaller falls.
Increases climb distance by ~15% when off cooldown. Has a cooldown of 3 seconds.
Slide jumping now also slightly increases climb distance.

talents.equipment: Bounty Hunter's Garb, Delver's Duster, Sandrunner Wraps, and Abyss Wanderer's Plate

talents.name: Steady Footing
talents.description: You're much more resistant to being pushed around.

info.text: Reduces knockback the user takes by 20%. (stacks with other sources of knockback resistance, including Anchor Pips)
This effect allows opponents to easier combo off of attacks that knock the user back, causing it to be not recommended outside PvE.
Removes ice's bonus slide distance, but does not affect the lowered friction when moving on ice.
This is a considerable downside to Frostdraw users, as there is no upside to this effect, it is not recommended.

talents.name: Time To Go
talents.description: Taking a life grants a speed boost for 10 seconds. Taking a player's life doubles the speed boost and the duration.

info.text: Provides a 25% speed boost, doubling to 50% when killing a player.
Procs all speed boost related talents. (ex. r=rare)
Duration is visually represented by a red glow by the user's eyes.
Can stack, allowing the user to build tremendous speed by executing multiple targets at once.

talents.name: An Ironsinger's Instinct
talents.description: Successfully dodging an attack coats you in metal and reduces the damage of the next attack taken.

info.text: After dodging gain the Ironsinger's Instinct status effect for 2 seconds, reducing the damage of the next hit by 60%.
The user visually gains a grey metallic shine upon for the duration, clearing on hit.
Has a cooldown of 18 seconds, starting immediately upon dodge.

talents.name: Exposed Durability
talents.description: Deal 10% more damage to opponents with no armor durability left.

info.text: Also applies to players who are wearing the Stranded Outfit.
This synergizes extremely well with abilities that drain your opponent's armor durability, such as the Arachnid's Weave's Corrosive Touch and the Metal Enchantment.

talents.name: Phantom Edge
talents.description: Your weapon M1's have +0.25 range.

info.text: It is not recommended to take this Talent, as its effect is objectively, unnoticeably minuscule.
Stacks with other sources of weapon range increases, such as Duelist's Lunge.

talents.name: Everchanging Aegis
talents.description: You take 20% less from attacks the same element as the last element you were hit with, but 10% more damage from attacks from different element.

info.text: Getting hit by another element immediately changes your resistance to that element. i.e Getting hit by Shadowcast Mantras while having Galebreathe resistance will immediately change your resistance type to Shadowcast and vice versa.
This means that multi-hitting Mantras are much less potent, even if your Everchanging Aegis was not attuned to that damage type.
Your Aegis type can swap on block, dodge, and parry. You do not need to actually be hit by the attack for the swap to occur, largely mitigating the downside.
Burn and self damage do not proc Everchanging Aegis.
The damage type you become resistant to is indicated by a colored shield, continuous damage of the same element will give a colored outline of the damage type.
Flamecharm: Orange / Frostdraw: Blue / Thundercall: Yellow / Galebreathe: Green / Shadowcast: Purple / Ironsing: Grey / Bloodrend: Red
Does not affect attacks that do not deal elemental damage.

talents.name: Neural Overload
talents.description: You can input up to 4 copies of each Mantra ingredient instead of being limited to 3.

info.text: The Mantra Modifiers limit is increased from 3 -> 4, for copies of modifiers. (ex. max of 3 crystal lens -> max of 4 crystal lens)
Removing this Talent after modifying Mantras will not alter their pre-existing modifiers, keeping the benefit.
This does not increase the maximum Mantra modification hard limit.

talents.name: Overflowing Dam
talents.description: Having full Ether for 2 seconds or more grants an aura to your attacks that grant them 10% more damage.

info.text: For every point of Intelligence below 40, Overflowing Dam's damage bonus will be reduced by 0.125%, having a minimum damage buff of 6.875% at 15 Intelligence.

For Warlock's and Ether Refined Mantle, you will gain a 5.625% damage buff at 5 Intelligence; for Khan with this equipment, you will gain a 5.25% damage buff at 2 Intelligence or a 5% damage buff at 0 Intelligence.

talents.equipment: Warlock's Mantle, Ether Refined Mantle, Sorcerer's Mantle

talents.name: Perfect Flash
talents.description: Having over 95% health causes your mantras expected=Mantras to do +25% damage. This damage bonus will scale down to 10% if your enemies are far away.

talents.name: Wyvern's Claw
talents.description: You deal 10% more damage while airborne. Mantras receive a 5% damage increase instead.

info.text: Activates after not being in contact with a grounded surface for ~0.75 seconds.
Synergizes very well with uppercuts.

talents.name: Aerogliding
talents.description: When falling from a high place, hold spacebar to generate wind currents until you hit the floor. Also gives you more airtime with Gliders.

info.text: Has a windup of 1 second.
When active, create an aura that reduces fall speed and stopping fall damage.
Does not prevent existing fall damage, if user was already falling, Aerogliding may still damage the user upon activation.
Automatically ends after 5 seconds, although it can be reactivated midair up to 3 times, however the windup will cause the user to take fall damage.
By air stalling you can continually reactivate Aerogliding and prevent fall damage.
When active, also lightly pushes user forwards, giving the user control.
Greatly reduces height loss with glider, allowing for much longer distances to be traveled. (Stacks with Feathered Glider)
The old "The Old Wind" Talent was merged into this.

talents.name: Gale Trap
talents.description: Knocking a player places a wind trap, causing anyone to pick up that body to get sent flying. Gain a speed boost picking up the body yourself. Killing PvE opponents gives you Gale Reflection instead.

info.text: Refer to Galetrap if you are looking for the Galebreathe Mantra instead.
Marks players knocked by you for 6s with "Gale Trap".
If the user picks up a target they've marked, they will gain a 35% speed boost for 20 seconds.
If anyone other than the user attempts to pick up the marked target, they will be ragdolled and flung upwards. This includes the user's allies.

Gale Reflection procs upon getting hit by an enemy, granting damage reduction to the attack and placing a Gale Trap on them. The damage of the Gale Trap scales with the strength of the enemy you killed.

talents.name: Stifled Jump
talents.description: Suffocating now applies Dazed if enemies jump. Suffocated PvE enemies now also get Sluggish when they are suffocated.

info.text: The Daze effect lasts for 1 second.
The Sluggish status effect applies a -15% damage debuff to affected targets.

talents.name: Suffocating Impact
talents.description: Flourishing enemies into walls applies Winded and Suffocating for a short duration.

talents.name: Vacuum Punch
talents.description: Your Gale Punch pulls enemies in before you hit them.

info.text: Gale Punch will now pull players towards the user during the windup of the Mantra. (Cannot be feinted)
Increases the windup of Gale Punch by 0.1s, totalling to 0.65s.

talents.name: Apothecary
talents.description: Potions you prepare will have amplified positive effects when consumed, and amplified negative effects when thrown.

info.text: Additively increases potion Potency by 125%. This is not displayed on the stats of your crafted potions. (More info on the potions page.)
The bonus acts similar to a potion ingredient, therefore Apothecary does nothing else after brewing.
The old Exterminator Talent was merged into this.

talents.equipment: Skeptic Pioneer, Alchemist's Hat, and Big Alchemist's Hat. It is encouraged to simply utilize these when brewing instead of taking this as a Talent card.

talents.name: Chain Reaction
talents.description: When applying a potion effect to someone who already has one, the new effect is amplified. You have a 25% chance not to deplete potions when drinking them.

info.text: Procs when a thrown potion replaces a different potion's effect. (Does not work on drank potions)
This effect increases the effectiveness of your potion by 40% and is applied multiplicatively to potency.
The old Taste Test Talent was merged into this.

talents.name: Chemistry Kit
talents.description: You no longer drop potions on death. You have a 25% chance to brew an extra potion.

info.text: Saltchemist salts innately make your potions not drop on death, however are not manually droppable.
When brewing potions, there's a 25% chance you'll gain 2 potions instead of 1.
The Wild Alchemy and Chemist's Bag Talents were merged into this Talent

talents.name: Placebo Effect
talents.description: Drinking potions near allies will share the potion's effect with them.

info.text: Also procs potion sickness, causing allies to throw up upon usage if they've ingested a potion recently.
Its effective range is exactly 30 studs.

talents.name: Potion Quaffer
talents.description: You're accustomed to drinking toxic fluids quickly. You'll get along famously with the other patrons at the tavern. Drinking potions slows less and grants superior regenerative effects to you.

info.text: Drink potions 30% faster. Potions take 1.645s to drink rather than the base 2.35s. When in combat, potions with Health Restoration (instant or regen) whether positive or negative now take 2.85s to drink rather than the base 3.55s.
The increased potion effectiveness is applied multiplicatively after Potency.
Increases the effectiveness of Health Regeneration potions by 15%. This only applies if the potion is drank.
Increases the effectiveness of Sanity Restoration and Ether Regeneration potions by 30%. This only applies if the potion is drank.
Removes the innate -25% effectiveness that Instant Health potions have, also increases their in-combat effectiveness from -75% to -50%. This only applies if the potion is drank.
The old Subsistence Talent was merged into this.

requirements.raw: 15 Fortitude // 15 Willpower, 30 Intelligence, interact with a Cauldron

talents.name: Approaching Singularity
talents.description: You now gain +1% Mantra PEN for every 10 point of Intelligence.

info.text: Gives 0.1% Mantra PEN per point in Intelligence.
Provides +8% PEN at the requirement, +5.5% PEN at the minimum requirement, and +10% PEN at 100 Intelligence.

talents.name: Conditioned Runner
talents.description: You take 5-15% less damage. The damage reduction amount scales with your agility stat and how long you have been running for.

info.text: This effect only applies while sprinting.
Currently bugged and does not work.

talents.name: Endurance Runner
talents.description: Your speed is decreased less by low health.

info.text: Halve the speed penalty tied to lost health.
Currently does not work.

talents.name: Scaredy Cat
talents.description: When enemies initiate a fight first, gain a speed boost.

info.text: Gives you a 42.5% speed boost for 5s.
The enemy must not be in combat to trigger this effect.

talents.name: Composite Path: Alloyblood
talents.description: Fuse the Ironsing rods from Ironsing mantras and Blood Poison from Bloodrend mantras into a composite plasma that flows in your opponents blood. Your Bloodrend mantras are now silver.

info.text: Your Metal Rod and Blood Poison buildup is replaced with Composite Alloy buildup. A certain threshold of Composite Alloy must be built up to cast Alloyblood Mantras.

talents.name: Hypoferritinemia
talents.description: Using Rising Plasma now summons your Metal Greatsword instead. Your Metal Greatsword now has an innate 75% chip, gaining even more chip based on how much composite plasma is inside your opponent.

info.text: The Rising Plasma Mantra now summons the Metal Greatsword instead of the Alloyblood Axe.

requirements.raw: Composite Path: Alloyblood, r=rare, Torture Mastery, 30 Bloodrend, 30 Ironsing

talents.name: Plasma Refresh
talents.description: When casting an alloyblood hybrid mantra, refresh your critical attack cooldown. Your critical hits with alloyblood weaponry now add composite plasma to your opponent.

info.text: Keep in mind that all of the Alloyblood weapons (Alloyblood Axe, Alloyblood Daggers, and Alloyblood Spear have the default critical attacks of their weapon types.

requirements.raw: Composite Path: Alloyblood, 40 Bloodrend, 40 Ironsing, 60 Weapon

talents.name: Plasma Signal
talents.description: Your opponent now signals a noise and are highlighted when they have enough plasma for you to cast your Rising Plasma mantra. Raise your opponent's plasma by 10% when this happens.

talents.name: Retained Hemoglobin
talents.description: Using an alloyblood mantra reduces the composite plasma cost of your next alloyblood mantra by 20%. This effect lasts for 10 seconds and can be stacked.

talents.name: Stored Plasma
talents.description: Feinting an alloyblood mantra increases the duration of the next weapon summoned from an alloyblood mantra by 33%.

talents.name: Ultrafiltration
talents.description: Filter out your bloodalloy hybrid mantras' composite plasma, allowing them to apply ironsing/bloodrend elemental effects once again.

info.text: Your Alloyblood Mantras (Infused Slash, Rising Plasma, and Spinning Serum) now apply Blood Poisoning and Metal Rods on hit.

talents.name: Flame Within
talents.description: An application of Pleeksty's concept of the inner flame, also known as the soul of man. Set yourself ablaze to gain more move speed and 10% extra damage.

info.text: Costs 25 Ether to activate.
Unlike normal burn, Flame Within's burn is not cleared by rolling or sliding. Flame Within will not stop until 30 seconds have passed or until Flame Within is reused.

Flame Within has an 8 second cooldown that starts when Flame Within is activated. Meaning if you let it burn for long enough, the cooldown will effectively be nullified outside of burn immunity. The Talent tool does not showcase this properly.
Flame Within grants a mobility buff, NOT a speed boost (it will not proc Talents such as r=rare).
It grants a general damage buff, and as such it'll affect all sources of damage that can be modified.
Flame Within can be enabled while knocked Unconscious. This is meant to synergize with r=advanced. Though, doing so will halve the strength of r=advanced.
Deals self-damage on cast, separate from the burn damage. This self damage can be resisted with the Deepscorn Casque's Already Dead Talent, Flamecharm resistance, and general resistances.

The burn damage can be reduced with Flamecharm resistance, Immolation, Flame Wisp, Parasol Planter's Grotesque Resilience (25% damage reduction), Flame Worshipper Armor's Intrepid Flame, Worshipper's Shield's Worshipper Tolerance, and sources of general damage reduction. It is recommended to have low Flamecharm investment on Flame Within builds to minimize the damage taken.
Deepfire Ring will lower Flame Within's duration down to 25s without affecting the burn damage taken. This is a direct debuff for Flame within.
The old Last Laugh Talent was merged into Flame Within.

talents.name: Fisher's Lure
talents.description: Fish are drawn to your line more quickly.

info.text: Reduces the amount of time it takes to get a bite.

talents.name: Hook, Line, and Sinker
talents.description: Once something's caught your line, it's much harder for it to get loose.

info.text: Increases the amount of time provided to complete the fishing minigame.

talents.name: Proficient Baiting
talents.description: Casting your line excites ocea life, reducing the chances of fishing up trash.

info.text: Drastically increases the chances of catching fish instead of junk items.
This inadvertently reduces the chances of fishing up chests however, due to fish being more common.

talents.name: Collapsed Lung
talents.description: Block breaking an opponent closes off their ability to Vent for 8s, with this duration scaling with Strength. PvE enemies instead get Collapsed.

info.text: The Vent negation duration scales with investment up to its requirement, this effect lasts 8 seconds at 100 Strength and loses 0.04s for every investment point below 100 Strength.
Collapsed Lung will have a 7 second duration at 75 Strength.
The Collapsed status effect decreases the posture damage affected targets deal to you by 40%.

talents.name: Carnivore
talents.description: In return for losing the ability to eat vegetation, satiate your hunger by killing others.

info.text: You now vomit when consuming plant-based Food items. Generic and Meat-type foods are still consumable.
Gain hunger and thirst upon executing an monster, NPC, or player. The nourishment gained scales on the strength of the target.
Does not work on certain mobs, such as Servants of Enmity, or player-summoned Lightning Clones.

talents.name: Grand Feast
talents.description: Regain tempo, ether, blood and health when gaining hunger from killing.

info.text: The healing is negated while in PVP combat.
On r=rare proc, replenish 40% of your maximum Tempo, 55% of your maximum Ether, 3% of your maximum blood, and 5% of your maximum health.

talents.name: Sunken Predator
talents.description: Enemies you hit in the water or the depths have their speed buffs nullified and are slowed.

info.text: Monsters are greatly slowed for a few seconds and can be frozen in place with enough hits.
Players are only slowed a little bit, and for less time as well.

talents.name: Devastating Power
talents.description: Gain extra Ether for every Mantra in your arsenal.

info.text: Gain 10 Ether for every Mantra you have. Unequipped Mantras provide Ether as well.

talents.name: Arc Module: Dash
talents.description: Your dashes become Jet Dashes, allowing you to attack while dashing.

info.text: Jet dashes go much further than regular dashes.
Also allows the user to M1 while performing a dash, ending their dash early.

talents.name: Arc Module: Eject
talents.description: When blockbroken, eject from your suit.

info.text: If your posture would reach 100% while in the Arc Suit, you instantly eject from it instead of being guard broken, launching yourself backwards and preventing stun.
Upon ejecting from the Arc Suit, your posture will be set to 50%.

requirements.raw: Oath: Arcwarder, defeat Chaser or Scion of Ethiron 1 time // pay Delta 10 to skip Arcwarder's progression entirely (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath at least once)

talents.name: Arc Module: Enhance
talents.description: Your Arcwarder Mantras deal increased damage.

info.text: Increases Arc Wave's base damage by 25%.
Increases Arc Beam's base damage by 50%.

Because Enhance increases your Mantra's base damage, it bypasses the damage modifier cap and increases the efficiency of your more conventional modifiers by giving them a higher base damage to work off of.

requirements.raw: Oath: Arcwarder, defeat Chaser or Scion of Ethiron X times // pay Delta 10 to skip Arcwarder's progression entirely (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath at least once)

talents.name: Arc Module: Guard
talents.description: You can block attacks from any direction and cannot be backstabbed.

requirements.raw: Oath: Arcwarder, defeat Chaser or Scion of Ethiron 2 times // pay Delta 10 to skip Arcwarder's progression entirely (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath at least once)

rare}}) cannot proc on you while you're in Arc Suit.

talents.name: Arc Module: Leap
talents.description: Holding Spacebar after double jumping propels you up for a short duration.

info.text: Allows you to double jump while in Arc Suit.
This has a 10 second cooldown. This cooldown is increased to 15 seconds if used while in combat.

requirements.raw: Oath: Arcwarder, defeat Chaser or Scion of Ethiron X times // pay Delta 10 to skip Arcwarder's progression entirely (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath at least once)

talents.name: Arc Module: Null
talents.description: Outgoing and incoming enchant effects are nullified. Can be toggled with N.

info.text: Toggling Null on/off has a 5 second cooldown.
Has a sound effect on toggle.
There is no way to tell if it is active or not until you attempt to use or get hit by an Enchantment.
Only affects weapon Enchantments.

requirements.raw: Oath: Arcwarder, defeat Chaser or Scion of Ethiron X times // pay Delta 10 to skip Arcwarder's progression entirely (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath at least once)

talents.name: Oath: Arcwarder
talents.description: You vow to be a shield for your comrades, to wear your regalia with pride and serve the greater collective. From each according to their ability, to each according to their needs.

info.text: See Oath: Arcwarder.

talents.stats: +1 Wildcard Mantra Slot, +2 Combat Mantra Slots, +5% PEN

requirements.raw: 20 Fortitude, 20 Flamecharm, 20 Thundercall, complete Alpha's quest

talents.name: Master Craftsman
talents.description: Your skills alone substitute the need for a Craft Station.

info.text: The user permanently gains the effects of the Crafting Station, allowing them to craft Crafting Station recipes from their inventory (e.g. Gliders).

talents.name: Deep Wound
talents.description: Assassinating a target applies anti-heal for 20s and gives you a speed boost for 6s. Assassination damage now scales with level against mobs.

info.text: The damage increase granted from this Talent is significantly high in PVE, allowing you to one shot some very tanky enemies like Authority Commander despite their 5000 HP.
Applies 60% Anti-Heal, signified by red cloud particles.

talents.name: Lights Out
talents.description: Assassinations now give you 30% PEN and blind the target for 5s. Those you carry are now blindfolded.

info.text: Targets being carried will have the Blinded visual effect, significantly hindering their vision.

talents.name: Lowstride
talents.description: When crouching, your stealth and roll distance are increased. Your speed while crouching is less slow You expected=slow. You draw your weapon silently.

info.text: Doubles the Stealth gain bonuses from crouching.
Crouching normally increases your Stealth by 1.5x and adds a flat +50 Stealth afterwards, but having Lowstride makes crouching increase your Stealth by 2x and add a flat 100 Stealth instead.
Stealth × 1.5 + 50 -> Stealth × 2 + 100.
Removes the SFX from sheathing and unsheathing your weapon.
Speeds up crouching to be fast as walking.
Increases roll distance by 15% when crouching.
Very strong synergy with "Murmur: Tacet", as it requires the user to crouch.

talents.equipment: Authority Peacekeeper Armor, Diver Journeyman Robes, Hive Adjudicator, Hive Drone, Pathfinder Sorcerer, Pathfinder Thaumaturge, Shadow Hunter, Steel Plate, Assassin's Cloak, Hive Scourge Cuirass, and Tracker's Boots

talents.name: Unseen Threat
talents.description: You can assassinate those with weapons out provided you're not in combat yourself. Those you assassinate are slowed and Grounded for 5s.

info.text: This Talent allows you to assassinate enemies who are in combat and holding a weapon.
The Grounded status effect prevents jumping.
The old Low Blow Talent was merged into this.

talents.name: Horn of Authority
talents.description: Mark escaping prisoners.

info.text: Grants a Talent tool that blows a horn, combat tagging and highlighting escaping prisoners.

talents.name: Authority Intimidation
talents.description: Lightning moves slow your opponent more.

info.text: Works with Surge Path.

talents.name: First Interrogation
talents.description: Attacks from opponents who are Electrified will give you ether proportional to their initial damage.

info.text: Only procs on weapon attacks from Electrified opponents.
Ether given is equal to half of the attack's scaled damage.
Still gives ether even if you block, parry, or dodge their attack.

talents.name: Resolve Crusher
talents.description: Lightning moves now apply stacks of 'Resolve Crusher'. At 4 stacks, you apply 'Electrified' to your opponent. Attacks from Electrified opponents are converted into lightning damage, but will deal 10% less damage to you.

info.text: Not to be confused with the Electrify Talent, Electrified targets have their damage on weapon attacks changed to Thundercall damage.
Electrified only reduces damage from weapon attacks.
Electrified procs when landing an attack that would apply the fifth stack, not the fourth.
Only Thundercall Mantras build up stacks for this. Thunder damage from any other source will not build up stacks.

Stacks last for 5 seconds. Stacks do not have independent durations; applying a new stack will refresh the duration of all stacks, but if you wait 5 seconds without applying a new stack, all of tour stacks will be lost.
Electrified, when procced, lasts for 4 seconds.
The visual effect for this Talent is currently bugged.

talents.name: Second Interrogation
talents.description: Opponents who are Electrified do 50% less damage and 50% less posture damage to you.

info.text: Does not stack with Resolve Crusher's damage reduction, instead it replaces it with this, more potent, effect.
Like Resolve Crusher, this, too, only applies to weapon attacks.

talents.name: Authority Ensign
talents.description: You are a member of the Authority deployed to the Eastern Luminant. You may find trouble with the local factions and must become stronger through advancing the Authority's position.

talents.name: Battle Tendency
talents.description: You can breathe more easily with +20% faster posture regen.

info.text: In combat, when not running or blocking, you regenerate posture passively. Battle Tendency increases this regen by +20%.

talents.name: Braced Collapse
talents.description: After being block broken, the next attack to hit you deals reduced damage.

info.text: After being block broken, reduce the next instance of damage by 20%. This has no cooldown.

talents.equipment: Abyss Wanderer's Plate, Delver's Duster, and Providence Coat

talents.name: Moving Fortress
talents.description: Blocking no longer slows you down as much

info.text: Increases your movement speed while blocking by 6.6%, from -25% movement speed to -18.4%.

talents.name: Perseverance
talents.description: Reduces the duration you're Ragdolled and Unconscious for by 25%.

info.text: This can stack with other Talents to reduce Unconscious time even further. (Ex. r=rare)

talents.name: Reinforced Armor
talents.description: Incoming PEN is reduced by 30%.

info.text: The effects of Reinforced Armor are lessened if you do not meet the Talent's requirements, losing 0.8% PEN resistance per point below 90 Fortitude, capping at 10% PEN resistance at 65 Fortitude.
Alternatively, this can be stated as 10 + 0.8 × (Fortitude - 65) = RA effectiveness, though this cannot go below 10% or above 30%.
PEN calculation: incoming PEN × (1 - Reinforced Armor effectiveness%) = reduced incoming PEN.
For example, 50% PEN vs 30% Reinforced Armor and 50% physical armor:
Base: 50% PEN vs 50% physical armor; 50 × (1 - 50%) = 25% resistance after PEN.
Reinforced Armor: 50% PEN vs 30% RA; 50 × (1 - 30%) = 35% PEN. 35% PEN vs 50% physical armor = 50 × (1 - 35%) = 32.5% resistance after PEN.

requirements.raw: Battle Tendency, Braced Collapse, Moving Fortress, Perseverance, 90 Fortitude

talents.name: Armored Plating
talents.description: Put on extra plating on your armor, giving you 50 temp health whenever you are put in combat. Due to the weight of this additional plating, you have reduced speed at all times.

info.text: Gain 50 Temporary Health whenever combat starts at the cost of having a passive movement speed debuff even outside of combat.

requirements.raw: Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

talents.name: Crossguard
talents.description: If you are using a sword, you gain 10% chip against other opponents wielding swords.

requirements.raw: Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

talents.name: Oppressive Force
talents.description: When using a weapon found in the Merit Armory, gain a unique two-hit flourish that does not knock back opponents and dazes them.

info.text: The first hit deals your regular M1 damage and posture damage, the second hit deals 80% of your weapon's scaled damage with 7 posture damage.
The damage and posture damage of the second hit cannot be buffed.
The second hit will only happen if the first one lands. This means it does not follow through on block.
The second hit does not count as a weapon hit, meaning it ignores your weapon's Chip stat, and it cannot proc enchants or any "on flourish" Talents.
The second hit does not proc on non-humanoid targets.

The following weapons can proc this effect: Adretian Axe, Big Brother, Cavalry Saber, Central Dirk, Duskguard Axe, Halberd, Inquisitor's Greatsword, Inquisitor's Thorn, Markor's Inheritor, Officer Saber, Rifle Spear, Rite of Authority, Sovereign's Punishment, and Warden Ceremonial Sword. Additionally, the Alloyed variants of all of these weapons will also proc it.
Despite being found in the armory, the Battleaxe, Stiletto, and Sword do not proc this effect.

requirements.raw: Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

talents.name: Riot Shield
talents.description: While you are fighting two or more opponents and are using a shield, reduce the total amount of chip damage you take by 40%.

info.text: Grants 40% damage reduction to chip damage, does not reduce your opponent's chip % by 40.

requirements.raw: Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

talents.name: Steel Tread
talents.description: Gain a bit of knockback resistance as well as damage resistance against attacks that ragdoll you.

requirements.raw: Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

talents.name: Berserk
talents.description: One with nothing to lose has everything to gain. Succumb to burning rage within and enter Berserk State.

info.text: While in the Berserk State, your M1s will gain increased PEN, scaling on how low your health is. This will cap at 50% if you do not have r=advanced. Additionally, your critical attacks gain +10% PEN. In exchange for this, all damage you take is true damage for the duration of the effect.
In PvE, your M1s always gain +100% PEN, regardless of your health value.
Lasts 20 seconds, halved to 10 seconds if you do not meet the Talent's Strength requirement.
Berserk can be deactivated after 10 seconds by using the Talent tool again.
Your eyes and hair turn red with your eyes gaining a red trail when activated as well. This is dyable. (Currently bugged, as hair color does not change)

talents.name: Heavy Cannonball
talents.description: Double the cooldown of your critical attack but increase the cannonball damage by 50%.

info.text: Specifically buffs the damage of the projectile on the Greatcannon criticals.

This equates to an ~29% net damage increase on the default Greatcannon critical, and an ~33% net damage increase on Smouldering Hallow's critical, assuming all hits land on the aforementioned critical attacks.
This does not work on the Edenbrand Hellcoil, as it does not fire a projectile.

Critical Engine with Blessed Gem can be used to revert your critical's cooldown back to the original value. Alternatively, the Summer Hullwrecker's Max Ammo Talent can be used to fully reset your critical cooldown when the cannonball lands.

talents.name: Mortar Mystery
talents.description: Landing a greatcannon critical attack summons mysterious cannonballs from above that target your opponent.

info.text: 3 mortar projectiles are spawned per critical attack damage instance landed, for each entity hit.
Each mortar projectile does 30 damage on hit.
Has a cooldown of 10 seconds, per target.

talents.name: Sticky Flames
talents.description: Your base greatcannon critical attack's cannon ball leave 3 seconds of sticky flames on successful hits.

info.text: The base Burn on the default Greatcannon critical is improved to Sticky Burn, meaning it cannot be removed for 3 seconds upon application.

talents.name: Float Like a Butterfly
talents.description: While having True Strength active, cancel your air dash to enter a frenzy of slashes.

info.text: It has a cooldown of 5 seconds.

requirements.raw: Oath: Bladeharper, Defeat Mind Reflection for the third time

talents.name: Lithe Step
talents.description: When Sprinting, roll-cancel and instantly vanish and surge with unmatched speed.

info.text: Makes the player briefly invisible, similar to Jetstriker's Rush of Ancients.
Lithe Step will not provide immunity frames to your dodge, but grants a noticeable speed boost during it.
Lithe Step has a 3 second cooldown. This cooldown is reduced to 1 second while in True Strength.

talents.name: Oath: Bladeharper
talents.description: You vow to carry your blades as an instrument, to lend yourself to any cause it guides you to. Collapse the infinite number of possibilities ahead of you into just one. The blade keeps you as much as you keep it.

info.text: See Oath: Bladeharper

requirements.raw: 25 Agility // 25 Strength, 75 MED // a combined total of 90 in any weapon stat (75 MED // LHT + MED + HVY ≥ 90), defeat yourself after interacting with a Sky Statue

talents.name: Reveal
talents.description: Pour your heart out, and reveal your true strength.

info.text: Grants a Talent tool. On cast, you stab yourself with your weapon, toggling on True Strength. Use the tool again to toggle True Strength back off.
While Reveal's True Strength state, you passively build up Wither on yourself.
If you go below 10% HP, Reveal will automatically turn itself off, and it cannot be turned back on again until you have over 10% health.

Oddly enough, Reveal procs things that require you to take damage like Prediction despite Reveal not actually dealing damage. Your current HP does not need to get replaced with Wither for this to take affect, and other sources of Wither application/True Strength do not do this.

requirements.raw: Oath: Bladeharper, Defeat Mind Reflection for the third time

talents.name: Soaring Storm
talents.description: Empower your uppercuts with the way of the blade, after Lithe Stepping, flourishing, or landing an Oath ability.

info.text: Proc condition is removed and damage is increased if in True Strength.
Applies to all forms of uppercuts, including Mantras such as Rising Flame, Round Spark Skyshatter Kick, or certain weapon criticals such as the Wraithclaw.

requirements.raw: Oath: Bladeharper, Defeat Mind Reflection for the second time

talents.name: Untouchable
talents.description: By landing consecutive hits on your opponent without taking any damage, reveal your True Strength for a short duration.

info.text: Upon proccing Untouchable, enter the True Strength state for 15 seconds.
Untouchable requires 10 'Untouchable Stacks'. Being hit by any non-self damage source will reset all Untouchable Stacks. You cannot build up Untouchable Stacks while True Strength is active.
Landing weapon attacks will build up 2 stacks each.
Landing non weapon attacks (like Burn, Mantras, Eruptions, etc.) build up 1 stack each. Bleed does not build up stacks however.

requirements.raw: Oath: Bladeharper, Defeat Mind Reflection for the second time

talents.name: Anchor Shock
talents.description: Your Blightshock prevents targets from using mobility mantras expected=Mantras.

info.text: This puts your opponent's mobility slot Mantras on a 3 second cooldown whenever Blightshock is applied from a Blightsurger Mantra.
This does not proc on the Blightshock from the Sovereign Bangle weapon.

requirements.raw: Oath: Blightsurger, use Sovereign State while in combat 50 times

talents.name: Blight Pierce
talents.description: Your Blightshock attacks pierce through your enemies hyperarmor and gain more penetration.

info.text: Blightshock now works similar to regular Shock, canceling Hyperarmor.
Sovereign Bangle, the Blightsurger exclusive weapon, and Blightsurge Mantras gain +15% more PEN.
Because Blightsurger Mantras deal pure Oath damage, the PEN given to your Mantras only matter in specific scenarios, such as fighting an Oathless player, or someone who is using Reinforce.

requirements.raw: Oath: Blightsurger, use Sovereign State while in combat 30 times

talents.name: Blighted Touch
talents.description: Landing Basic Attacks during Sovereign State now applies Blightshock.

info.text: This allows your Sovereign Bangle to apply Wither on hit.

requirements.raw: Oath: Blightsurger, use Sovereign State while in combat 20 times

talents.name: Blightlash
talents.description: Your swing range is enhanced during Sovereign State.

info.text: Increases the range of the Sovereign Bangle from 6 to 7.

requirements.raw: Oath: Blightsurger, use Sovereign State while in combat 60 times

talents.name: Oath: Blightsurger
talents.description: Fists and storm. Wield sacred lightning, tear through foes and leave them withered.

info.text: See Oath: Blightsurger

talents.stats: +2 Combat Mantra Slots, +1 Wildcard Mantra Slot, +5% PEN

requirements.raw: Combined total of 80 in Strength/Fortitude/Agility (STR + FTD + AGL ≥ 80), combined total of 40 in Galebreathe/Thundercall (WND + LTN ≥ 40), high ally The Hundred Legions reputation, defeat Titus, speak to Brutus

talents.name: Sovereign State
talents.description: Landing physical hits builds your Blight Meter. At full gauge, enter a Blight State that changes your critical and empowers Blightsurge abilities.

info.text: Blight Meter gain has no cooldown. Landing Blightsurger Mantras grants 15% Blight Meter. Landing Basic Attacks grants 10% Blight Meter. Landing weapon criticals, Thundercall Mantras, or Galebreathe Mantras grants 5% Blight Meter per hit.
At full Blight Meter, Sovereign State lasts 12.5 seconds.
Sovereign State has a 10 second activation cooldown once the duration runs out.
You can press X while having at least 30% Blight Meter to activate Sovereign State. While in Sovereign State, your Blight Meter will passively decay, and it cannot be deactivated.
While in Sovereign State, your weapon will be replaced with the Sovereign Bangle.
Skycrash will be automatically used twice in quick succession while in this state.
Increases the Wither damage that Sovereign Drive and Warp Kick deal.

talents.name: All-Seeing Eye
talents.description: The mystic eye through which you now see the world can perceive the imperceptible. Invisible foes are highlighted.

info.text: Invisible players and monsters are revealed by a Blindseer Eye icon showcasing their current position.
Specifically reveals players under the effects of r=advanced, Static Flash Clone, r=oath, Tacet, Illusory Servants' casting animation, Beast Burrow, Portals, and other invisibility effects.
Abilities with lock-on targetting (e.g. Ice Daggers) can target invisible entities while you have this Talent.
This works on anyone who is invisible, yourself and monsters included.
Because your body is rendered out while in first person, All-Seeing Eye triggers on yourself. You can see the swirling effect if you look downwards.

requirements.raw: Oath: Blindseer, help 4 Pathfinders without Oaths escape their Depths Trials OR pay 10 to the wall text you obtained the Oath from to skip Blindseer's progression entirely (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath at least once)

talents.name: Oath: Blindseer
talents.description: You vow to not let the horrors of the world pierce your tightly fastened blindfold. Everything is simply as we choose to perceive it.

info.text: See Oath: Blindseer.
Note: you can remove the prerequisite Talents after obtaining this Oath.

talents.stats: +1 Combat Mantra Slot, +1 Support Mantra Slot, +1 Wildcard Mantra Slot, +5% PEN, +10 Sanity

requirements.raw: Breathing Exercise, Conquer Your Fears, Disbelief, Blinded Talent // Blind Flaw, 40 Willpower, and read the inscriptions in The Temple of the Forgotten Flame

talents.name: Bloodwarden's Sense
talents.description: Enemies you attack with a mantra expected=Mantra above 60% Blood Poisoning are marked with Bloodwarden's Mark for 5s.

info.text: While affected by Bloodwarden's Mark, your character is highlighted red and you take 20% more Blood Poisoning.

talents.name: Smell of Blood
talents.description: Enemies that touch your blood pools or are blockbroken by you are afflicted with Bloodscent for 6s.

info.text: Bloodscent shows your opponent's blood percentage or blood hemorrhage percentage in PvE as a red number, and their Blood Poisoning percentage as a pink number.

talents.name: Adept Bloodrender
talents.description: You can now obtain 1-star Bloodrender mantras.

info.text: This Talent will be removed from you if you no longer meet its requirements.

talents.name: Blood Bag
talents.description: You receive extra blood from knocking an enemy.

talents.name: Blood Transfusion
talents.description: Successfully landing a critical attack while under a negative status effect will transfer the effect plus recover a small portion of your blood bar. (20 second cooldown)

talents.name: Bloodrender
talents.description: Grants you the ability to command Blood as a Bloodrender. Your Bloodrend mantras replenish your blood, steal blood and apply 'Blood Poisoning'.

info.text: Blood Poison is an effect that is overlayed on top of your opponent's blood bar. Upon reaching certain Blood Poison thresholds (percentage of the blood bar covered with Poison), you will apply debuffs to the target and may proc certain conditional Talent effects.
Blood poison passively drains over time, requiring you to constantly apply pressure to maintain the debuffs.
See Bloodrend for more info.

talents.name: Crimson Fountain
talents.description: Blockbreaking or flourishing an enemy now spills a pool of blood below them. Blood mantras expected=Mantras cast within blood pools have a reduced blood cost.

talents.name: Expert Bloodrender
talents.description: You can now obtain 2-star Bloodrender mantras.

info.text: This Talent will be removed from you if you no longer meet its requirements.

talents.name: First Blood
talents.description: Your first blood mantra you use in combat has no blood cost and deals additional blood drain .

talents.name: Hemorrhaging Blow
talents.description: Block breaking your opponent with a blood mantra turns your opponent's combat healing into damage for 8 seconds

info.text: 55 second cooldown, with the cooldown starting on guard break.
The damage to healing conversion is 1:1, meaning 20 healing = 20 damage.

It works on all (non passive) healing, meaning you can block break them and then use something that would heal them them for additional damage. This however doesn't work on things like Health Regen Potions or r=advanced as that they are forms of passive healing.
Works with Mindsoothe, Blood Scourge bell, r=rare, Fadetrimmer's Revitalizing Hair Spray, etc.

talents.name: Just a Taste
talents.description: First Bloodrend mantra expected=Mantra you hit in combat has increased blood drain.

info.text: Currently does not work.

talents.name: Master Bloodrender
talents.description: You can now obtain 3-star Bloodrender mantras. Your maximum blood capacity is 25% more than a normal individual. You regen blood at a quicker pace.

info.text: This Talent will be removed from you if you no longer meet its requirements.

talents.name: Open Wound
talents.description: Guardbreaking enemies leaves enemies more susceptible to blood loss from Bloodrend mantras.

talents.name: Rush Hour
talents.description: Stab yourself to become stronger, faster, and deal increased blood bar damage.

info.text: Gives you the Rush Hour tool. Can be deactivated at any time by using the tool again.
Drains 4.5 health and 2% Blood per second.

Because this drains your health, instead of dealing damage, it isn't affected by sources of damage reduction (unless explicitly stated), ignores Temporary Health, and does not proc "on damage" conditionals.
Deepscorn Casque and the Enhanced Flow Talent are the only two effects in the game that can reduce the health drain from Rush Hour.
Grants a 15% damage buff, affected by the damage modifier cap.
Increases blood loss by +35% (additive).
Grants a 30% Speed Boost. This counts for Talents such as r=rare and r=rare.
Recover 5% Blood when dealing damage (0.35s cooldown). Burn damage cannot proc this effect.
If you have the Enhanced Flow Talent, landing basic attacks during Rush Hour will grant Temporary Health, equal to 30% of your weapon's scaled damage.
Having Rush Hour active doubles the duration of the Torture Mastery status effect.
ragdolled automatically cancel your Rush Hour. (Brick Wall not verified.)

talents.name: Sanguine Siphon
talents.description: Landing a critical attack while in a blood pool will consume that pool and empower your next blood mantra.

info.text: Buffs the next Mantra's damage by 25% upon proccing, signified by flowing blood out of your hands.
Effect lasts 15s before disappearing.

talents.name: Blood and Iron
talents.description: Pulling rods out of your opponent now replenishes an equivalent amount of blood.

talents.name: Brain Death
talents.description: Enemies that are already suffocated will have their suffocation duration extended when hit by a bloodrend mantra expected=Mantra.

info.text: Applies a new stack of suffocation for 2.5s on proc.

talents.name: Cold Blooded
talents.description: Chilled enemies passively build up blood poison, alternatively when crystals explode it'll apply blood poison. (DOES NOT STACK)

info.text: Has a 0.5s cooldown.
Applies 25% blood poisoning on crystal explosion.

This Talent does not proc on Crystal explosions caused via guardbreaking the target or Temperature Shock. Instead, all crystal explosions must be procced through applying enough crystals or Golden Age in order for this Talent to proc.

talents.name: Electrolyte
talents.description: Hitting Bloodrend mantras expected=Mantras while having temporary health applies Shocked while removing a portion of temporary health.

info.text: Applies a Surge Rod instead if you have Surge Path: Unstable Capacitor.
Takes 4 temporary health per proc.

talents.name: Malevolent Sapper
talents.description: The more blood poisoning your opponent has, the more ether your shadow mantras expected=Mantras steal from your opponent.

talents.name: Scorchblood
talents.description: Guardbreaking your opponent using a bloodrend mantra expected=Mantra causes a blood explosion, setting your opponent on fire and poisoning their blood.

info.text: Deals 16.5 damage in an AoE on proc.
Applies burn before Scorched Peak does a check to see if your opponent is burning, meaning Scorched Peak will be instantly procced if you guardbreak with a Bloodrend Mantra.

talents.name: Agility Unbounded
talents.description: You have gained the ability to surpass your limits and train your agility to its fullest.

info.text: Obtaining this Talent at any point removes the quest part of the obtainment on all subsequent characters, immediately giving you the Talent upon reaching its attribute requirement.
If your chosen Aspect innately grants increased Agility, and you do not have Multifaceted, then the Agility requirement to obtain this Talent will be increased by 2-3.

talents.name: Bruiser's Mixup
talents.description: Switching your Fist Style mid-fight makes your basic Fist attacks inflict bleed temporarily.

info.text: Lasts for 4 seconds.
Procs by pressing Y (Works even if you only have one Fist Style)
There is an 8 Second cooldown between style changes.
This Talent does not work with Jus Karita.

talents.name: Brazen Blow
talents.description: Attacking an enemy slowed by your Greataxe grants you temporary Hyperarmor.

info.text: The hyperarmor lasts 1 second. 20 second cooldown.
Only procs on weapon attacks.
Does not proc on uppercut.

requirements.raw: Use a Greataxe, Impairing Blow, 30 Heavy Weapon

talents.name: Corrosive Touch
talents.description: Landing a successful Critical Attack or Flourish will corrode a portion of your opponent's Armor.

info.text: Drain 5% of your opponent's armor on proc. This has a 10 second cooldown and can only proc once per critical attack.

talents.name: Heavy Fatigue
talents.description: Hitting an enemy slowed by your Greataxe temporarily reduces how far they can roll and applies Sluggish to PvE enemies for a few seconds.

info.text: Reduces opponents roll distance by 25% for 2.5s.
The Sluggish status effect applies a -15% damage debuff to affected targets.
Does not proc on uppercut.

requirements.raw: Use a Greataxe, Impairing Blow, 40 Heavy Weapon

talents.name: Impairing Blow
talents.description: Basic Attacks will slightly slow your enemy for 2 seconds. Running attacks will slow your enemy for 3 seconds. Gain +20% posture damage against enemies with speed boosts.

info.text: Does not proc on uppercut.
Reduces the opponents speed by a flat value of 5.

talents.name: Rending Impact
talents.description: Block breaking an enemy applies knockdown.

info.text: Only procs on guardbreaks from weapon attacks.
Applies knockdown for 1.2 seconds.
The default guardbreak stun is 1.05s, so this effectively increases the time someone is stunned after being guardbroken by 0.15s.
30 second proc cooldown.

talents.name: Dancing Guard
talents.description: Parrying an opponent and then parrying another enemy in quick succession applies slow for 7s.

info.text: Dancing Guard's duration will be reduced by 0.086s for every point in Fortitude below its requirements, having a minimum duration of 4.86s at 30 Fortitude.

talents.name: Defensive Reprisal
talents.description: Being flourished grants you 10% posture resistance for 20s.

info.text: Defensive Reprisal's duration will be reduced by 0.177s for every point in Fortitude below its requirements, having a minimum duration of 15.55s duration with 40 Fortitude.

talents.name: Down to your Level
talents.description: While you have a speed debuff, your Basic Attacks slow your enemies for 5s.

info.text: Down to your Level's duration will be reduced by 0.05s for every point in Fortitude below 60, capping at a minimum of 3.75s with 35 Fortitude.
The slow only procs on M1s, and criticals with the M1 tag.
Procs from Entaglement, Daze, Chill and most other things that slow you down.
Does not proc from Grand Fisher Plate or Wormwarder Lantern despite them reducing your movement speed.

talents.name: Knuckle Guard
talents.description: Hitting Dazed enemies grants you 10% posture resistance for 15s.

info.text: Knuckle Guard's duration will be reduced by 0.1s for every point of Fortitude and Strength below its requirements, having a minimum possible duration of 10.4 seconds with 30 Fortitude and 4 Strength, though this isn't very realistic.

talents.name: Evasive Expert
talents.description: Your speed boost granted from dodging is increased.

info.text: Increases your Swift Rebound speed boost from 30% to 50%.

talents.name: Ghost
talents.description: Dodging a move will briefly make you invisible, ending early if you attack.

info.text: Provides I-frames for the duration of the invisibility.
The invisibility and I-frame duration is 1.2 seconds if you have 40 or higher Agility.
Ghost's duration will be reduced by 0.0133 seconds per point in Agility under 40, capping at 0.866 seconds at 15 Agility.
Has a 20 second cooldown.
You cannot parry attacks during the invisibility.

talents.name: Risky Moves
talents.description: When you successfully dodge, you'll automatically dodge the next attack.

info.text: User is covered in a blue highlight when the effect is active.
Visual effect might not line up with duration.
Attacking will cancel the effect early.
Takes priority over block, allowing for you to "auto-dodge" while simultaneously blocking.
20 second cooldown.

talents.name: Swift Rebound
talents.description: Move faster after successfully dodging an attack.

info.text: Provides a 30% speed boost for 2s.

talents.name: Chainlash
talents.description: On flourish, gain the ability to summon a chain on an enemy for 5 seconds by right clicking. This lets you whip your chain to seize and yank enemies towards you, setting them up for a crushing kick.

info.text: Pressing M2 after landing a flourish will apply Enchained to your opponent, pulling them to you. M1ing after the pull will perform a Crushing Kick, dealing high damage.
The pull will bring the targets back to the location you flourished and prevent movement for a duration.
Chainlash will only work on Chained targets, if a target breaks the chain quick enough, Chainlash will cancel.
Works with other "on Flourish" Talents.
The kick ragdolls and flings targets in the direction you are looking, but cannot wallbang.
This does not proc on non-humanoid targets.

talents.description: You vow to be the chain that binds the wicked and drags them back where they belong. There are those in this world who should not be free.

talents.name: Perpetual Wrath
talents.description: Unleash the true power of Restrain. Each successive hit will increase its damage.

info.text: Enchaining targets and hitting Chained targets with with Restrain will add 1 stack of Perpetual Wrath.
Each stack of Perpetual Wrath increases Restrain's (Mantra) damage by 8, capping out at 4 stacks for +32 damage. At max stacks, Restrain additionally gains a new visual and sound effect.
All stacks of Perpetual Wrath will be cleared if the chain breaks.

requirements.raw: Oath: Chainwarden, Defeat one humanoid boss or player with Hunted Authority reputation and grip them while they're Chained // give Vice Warden Morredh 10 instantly skipping Chainwarden's progression (this can only be done if you've fully progressed the Oath at least once).

talents.name: Champion's Regalia
talents.description: Flourishing an opponent grants you +50% posture damage on Basic Attacks for 10 seconds.

info.text: Indicated by a gold shaded outline on your character.
Does not work on non-humanoid NPCs.

talents.name: Defiance
talents.description: Negative status effects are half as effective when you are below 35% HP.

info.text: The Effectiveness of Defiance will be lessened if you do not meet its Willpower requirement.
Currently, the only things Defiance cuts in half are:
Flamecharm's Burn damage
Frostdraw's Chill duration and Crystal stacks
Galebreathe's Winded and Suffocation duration
Thundercall's Surge stacks
Shadowcast's Sightless Still duration
Blood Poisoning
Wither gain
Ring of Pestilence duration
The potency of potions
Time Unconscious (cut by 50% multiplicatively after other modifiers)

talents.name: Underdog
talents.description: You deal 2.5% more damage to those with higher HP than you, scaling up to 4% at 60 WLL. Additionally, you deal +10% more damage to physically larger foes.

info.text: Underdog's damage to enemies with higher HP than you scales with your Willpower investment.
Underdog grants a 2.5% damage buff at 20 Willpower, this is increased by 0.0375% damage per Willpower above 20, capping at 4% with 60 Willpower.
Underdog will grant a 2.875% damage bonus at requirements.
"Higher HP" refers to current HP.
"Larger foes" refers to NPCs who are actually large-sized. (e.g., works on Megalodaunts, does not work on Threshers)
Large sized foes cannot be grabbed by grab attacks.

talents.name: Chaotic Charm
talents.description: Charm enemies nearby when attacked at low health. Enemies affected by this charm have their damage increased to anyone but you, and deal reduced damage towards you.

info.text: Procs when taking damage while at or below 25% of your maximum health.

Applies a unique status effect, Chaotic Charm, for 15 seconds that is separate to charm as a whole. This status effect is what grants the additional damage reduction and increased damage to people who are not you. This status effect cannot have its duration reduced by Disbelief.
The additional damage reduction from Chaotic Charm scales on your Charisma investment, gaining 0.15% damage reduction per point in Charisma.
This damage reduction is combined multiplicatively with Charm due to them being separate status effects.
The Charm application can proc Narcissist.
Deals 0.1 typeless damage in an AoE whenever it procs, applying a Combat Tag and Charm to targets hit. 0.25s cooldown.
Can be blocked, preventing damage and Charm proc.
Typeless self damage does not proc Chaotic Charm, but something like Flame Within will.

talents.name: Charismatic Cast
talents.description: Landing a hit with a Mantra on an enemy applies Charmed. Allies recover from being knocked twice as quickly when Charmed by you.

info.text: This charm lasts 10s.
Targets you've Charmed will deal 10% less damage to you.

When applying Charm to an already Charmed target, if the new Charm's total duration is longer than the current Charm's remaining duration, the original Charm will be replaced. If not, nothing will happen. It is highly recommended that you have Lasting Charisma if you wish to get use out of Charismatic Cast during ganks and other team fights.

talents.name: Dazing Finisher
talents.description: Flourishing enemies that are Charmed by you cause them to not be knocked back and Dazed instead.

info.text: Applies Daze for 3.35 seconds on proc.
This duration is reduced by 0.02 seconds for every point under 55 Charisma, having a minimum duration of 2.85 seconds at 30 Charisma.
Prevents you from knocking back charmed players with flourishes, instead, dazing them.

requirements.raw: Chaotic Charm, Charismatic Cast, Lasting Charisma, Tough Love, 55 Charisma

talents.name: Lasting Charisma
talents.description: Enemies charmed by your mantras expected=Mantras are charmed longer.

info.text: Lasting Charisma increases the duration of Charismatic Cast's Charm from 10s to 20s.

If you do not meet Lasting Charisma's investment requirement, the additional Charm duration will be reduced, losing 0.166s for every point of Charisma you have under 55, capping at a minimum of 15.83 seconds of Charm with 30 Charisma.

talents.name: Tough Love
talents.description: Deal 10% more damage to enemies Charmed by you. Mantras deal +5% instead. Being hit by someone the same Aspect or Oath as you applies Charmed briefly.

info.text: Charms for 2 seconds with a 1 second cooldown.
If attacked while on cooldown, the cooldown timer resets and you have to wait another second again to be able to proc Tough Love's Charm.
The damage increase affects all sources of Charm, not exclusively Tough Love.
Procs its charm through block, parry, and dodge.

This damage buff is only applied if your Charm is applied to the target. Due to how Charm works, it is highly recommended that you have a high Charm duration from Lasting Charisma if you wish for this Talent to function in large-scale ganks.

Instead of your charm debuffing affected players and making them take more damage, it actually applies an on-hit buff when attacking someone affected by your charm, granting a damage buff to that attack. This means Tough Love is affected by the damage modifier cap.

talents.name: Freezing Wight
talents.description: Your Haunted Gale now procs Chillled.

info.text: Also works with Specter Path's Apparitions, turning them light blue.
Applies 7 seconds of Chill or 1 Crystal.

Changes the damage type of Haunted Gale Ghosts/Specter Apparitions from pure Galebreathe to Galebreathe & Frostdraw, making them easier to resist, while allowing them to proc things that require the Frostdraw damage type (e.g. Flashboil).

talents.name: Destructive Recovery
talents.description: Enemies recover 20% less Posture when parrying.

talents.description: Your posture damage is increased by 5%.

talents.description: You take 15% less posture damage when parried.

talents.description: Everyone you buff with Reinforce is healed lightly. You're healed slightly if you heal others.

info.text: Heals others by 3% of their maximum health.
Heals the user by 2% of their maximum health + an additional 1% for every extra person healed. This only procs if you buff at least 1 ally with your Reinforce.
Only procs on allies.

talents.description: Everyone you Reinforce is drained of their Ether while Reinforced. Drain scales with your Shadowcast. Drain health from PvE opponents as well.

info.text: While the effect is active, victims can hold block to stop ether drain.
Lord's Tithe cancels on victims once they drop beneath 5% Ether.
Getting hit or blocking an attack will cancel the effect entirely.
Note: Despite this Talent requiring 40 Fortitude, the Reinforce Mantra requires 50.

talents.name: Hidden Tendril
talents.description: Landing any physical mantra expected=Mantra places a Hidden Tendril on the opponent.

info.text: Physical critical attacks, uppercuts, flourishes, and most attunement-less Mantras will apply a Hidden Tendril.

talents.stats: +2 Combat Mantra Slots, +1 Wildcard Mantra Slot, +5% PEN

talents.description: Pulls together any two opponents you've attached Hidden Tendril to.

talents.name: Pressure Detonation
talents.description: Block breaking an opponent with a Shadow mantra expected=Mantra generates a small vacuum that suffocates those hit and steals their Tempo.

info.text: If the user has the Apparitions Talent, this can proc Apparitions by inflicting suffocation.

talents.name: Decisive Blow
talents.description: Hitting an enemy with your Critical Attack immediately after they dodge (or any time against mobs) now procs Knife's Journey. Your Knife's Journey procs do 2x Armor damage.

info.text: While the effect is active, gain a red trail on your weapon. The red trail will show up on non-daggers, but will have no effect unless you have the r=advanced Talent.
Compatible with r=advanced despite technically not being a Dagger Talent.

talents.name: Finishing Touch
talents.description: Instantly execute enemies finished with the critical attack of your dagger.

info.text: Your critical must knock the opponent Unconscious for this Talent to proc.

talents.name: Knife's Journey
talents.description: Cancelling an enemy's Mantra windup with your Basic Attacks now deals 15% more damage.

info.text: Displays a red particle on the target enemy after proccing.
Though not mentioned in the Talent description, Daggers gain a 15% chance to critically hit on basic attacks in PVE, dealing 5x damage. This has a 15 second cooldown.
This does not work on non-Dagger weapons via r=advanced. Additionally, Moppet's critical attack cannot critically hit.
Critical hits do not proc "on critical attack" Talents.

talents.name: Successive Throw
talents.description: When you successfully flourish an enemy, you throw out a dagger afterwards.

info.text: If your cursor isn't on an enemy after flourishing them, it will throw it at the enemy closest to your cursor. If your cursor is on a separate player from who you flourished, the dagger will be thrown at them instead.
The projectile will be fired after a 1.5 second delay.
If the target is too close to you, the thrown dagger projectile will be invisible; otherwise, the thrown dagger projectile will look similar to Ice Daggers' projectile.
Deals 5 damage on proc.

talents.name: Chilling Flourish
talents.description: When flourishing an enemy, they leave behind a trail of ice in the direction you send them.

info.text: Leaves 3-4 ice patches on the ground.

talents.name: Condensation Drip
talents.description: Passively collect condensation from the air, greatly reducing your thirst.

info.text: Slows thirst drain by approximately 3 times.

talents.name: Cool Head
talents.description: If set on fire while on ice, immediately put it out and gain the Cool Head status for 30s. During Cool Head, you cannot be lit on fire.

info.text: 15 second cooldown, starting when the effect ends.
While the effect is active, the user breathes cold air.

talents.name: Fragile Freeze
talents.description: Your Basic Attacks and Criticals now apply Frozen to Chilled opponents on guardbreak.

info.text: Guardbreaking a chilled opponent with a weapon attack will encase them in ice, removing their ability to move, parry, block, or dodge for a short amount of time.
Taking damage by any source (including damage over time effects) will end the freeze early.
You can spam parry, Space, or dodge to get out of Freeze faster.

talents.name: Preceding Chill
talents.description: Enemies hit during the last moments of your ice beam are frozen.

info.text: If the user has Crystallization, this Talent no longer freezes but instead causes crystals to explode.
You can spam parry, Space, or dodge to get out of the ice faster.

talents.name: Spike Traps
talents.description: Press parry during the wind up of your Ice Spikes to create traps around you instead of spawning a spike in the normal spot.

info.text: Activates a spike upon being stepped on.
There are small, blue, transparent "traps" indicating the hitboxes, placed randomly around the user.
Can stack multiple times, allowing for very high amounts of traps in one spot.
Extends Ice Spike's cooldown by 5s, to 20s total.
text=Spike Traps is no longer obtainable. For users who already have Spike Traps, activating it will only place 1 trap, no matter how many Cloud/Stratus Stones the Mantra was modified with.

talents.name: Golden Age
talents.description: Your Iron Pull now detonates Crystals and overloads Surges.

talents.description: Gain a speed boost after causing an opponent heavy blood loss.

info.text: "Heavy Bloodloss" refers to around 1 bar of blood.
"Very short duration" (As described by Youtuber Agamatsu)

talents.name: In a Hurry
talents.description: You grip faster with a movement speed boost.

info.text: Reduces the time it takes to execute someone by 0.5 seconds (16.67% faster).

talents.name: Muffled Screams
talents.description: You quieten the cries of help of those you execute, reducing the distance at which their allies will hear it and come to assist, and reducing the effectiveness of Talents that slow your executions.

info.text: NPCs have a shortened aggro range from executing their allies in proximity.
Stay of Execution no longer affects your grip speed.

talents.name: Blighted Song
talents.description: Attaching your Shadow Chains to enemies disables yours and the enemy's ability to cast mantras expected=Mantras. You take reduced damage from enemies while this is applied.

info.text: Grants 20% damage reduction against attacks coming from entities that are not the caster or the person affected by Blighted Song.

talents.name: Dark God
talents.description: If a Shadowcast mantra expected=Mantra would drain your opponent's Ether to 0, drain from their Tempo instead and increase your Tempo. Shadowcast mantras expected=Mantra will now raise your tempo if your ether is full.

talents.name: Dark Hours
talents.description: Your Shadowcast Mantras deal 15% more damage at night and in realms the Sun does not reach.

info.text: Night cycle is XX:50 to XX:10 in IRL time.
Always active in the Depths.

talents.name: Dark Replenishment
talents.description: Knocking out an enemy in combat restores a portion of your ether.

talents.name: Dark Rift
talents.description: Enter a rifted state when you successfully dodge, where you can't be damaged until its duration ends. Can be cancelled early if you attack.

info.text: Blocking, parrying, dodging, or sliding will also cancel the effect.
You cannot use Mantras during the effect.
You hover with a dark outline while dark rift is active.
This ability lasts for 1.8 seconds and goes on a 20 second cooldown when it activates.

talents.name: Dark Synergy
talents.description: Engulf your enemy in shadows when flourishing them.

info.text: Deals 5 Shadowcast damage on proc.
Does not steal or halt any Ether regen.

talents.description: Anytime you guardbreak your opponent with a light attack or critical, steal half of your opponent's current tempo. Also apply Ether Sunder to PvE enemies.

info.text: The Ether Sunder status effect grants you 30% damage reduction against affected enemies' elemental attacks.

talents.name: Night Terror
talents.description: Your light attacks now proc Fear the Dark.

talents.description: If multiple enemies are hit by your Shadow Eruption, they are Dazed for 0.7s.

info.text: All elemental Status Effects cannot be applied to you during Absolute Radiance.

talents.description: You vow to forever reach towards the brilliant Light. There is no shadow that your radiance cannot expunge.

talents.description: Your singularity now pulls ether from extra players affected by Blackhole.

info.text: Takes around 15 Ether from the affected opponents on proc.

info.text: When the tool is used in the Overworld, play an animation and sink into the First Layer. This does not count as a drown.
When the tool is used in the First Layer, teleport to Castle Light with a 1 minute cooldown.

talents.name: Deepbound Contract
talents.description: You progress much faster in the Depths, and slower on the overworld. You can regain sanity at Castle Light, but will always face the strongest foes in your Trial.

info.text: You can always enter Castle Light and Chariot's Spire, even if you've drowned, or are a Contractor.
The turret outside of Castle Light may still attack you if you have bad reputation and/or are a Contractor.
Your Depths Trial will always be an Enforcer or harder.
You gain passive sanity regeneration at Castle Light.
Gain more experience while in the Depths, but your experience gain is reduced elsewhere.

talents.name: Spell Shout
talents.description: You will now shout your mantra expected=Mantra name upon cast.

info.text: The player will say the name of the Mantra they cast in a chat bubble. E.G casting Fire Blade will make the player say "Fire Blade!"
Renamed Mantras will use the new name. Casting Adrenaline Surge renamed to Speed Boost will say "Speed Boost!". You can rename Mantras by clicking on their name in the Mantra Lectern menu.
Mantra names are auto formatted so that caps are forced at the start of every word and cannot be elsewhere. Numbers also cannot be used. Casting a Mantra named "64 palms" will say "Palms!".
If a Mantra name gets moderated by Roblox's automated chat moderation, the shout will default to the original name of the Mantra.

IMPORTANT: Make sure to not use offensive names or slurs for your Mantras. This can result in moderation action taken against you.
Offensive includes mentions to Race, Gender, Sexual Preference, Religion, etc.

talents.description: Landing a critical with a Static Link on your opponent applies Chilled.

3 second cooldown.

talents.description: Knocking a player refreshes your Glorious Charge cooldown and extends both of its effects by 5 seconds. [90 second CD]

This Talent will proc every time you knock a player Unconscious. If it is already on cooldown, then knocking a player will add an extra instance of the cooldown, without doing anything else.

talents.name: Spine Cutter

info.text: 5 second cooldown per enemy. The cooldown indicator may suggest the cooldown is per enemy type, but it isn't.
Deals half of your weapon's scaled damage, with no PEN.
One second window to proc it after a roll cancel

talents.description: The duration you are Dazed from wall bangs is cut in half. Slightly reduce your guardbreak stun time from PvE enemies as well.

talents.description: Dodging immediately after a roll-cancel no longer puts your Dodge on a longer cooldown.

talents.name: Destructive Yell

talents.name: Eureka
talents.description: Gain a stack of Inspiration every time you land or parry a Mantra. Whiffing a Mantra removes a stack of Inspiration.

info.text: At 3 stacks, gain the Inspired buff for 30 seconds or until you cast a Mantra. Inspired increases the damage of your next Mantra cast by 10%.

info.text: This deals a separate instance of physical damage which is parriable, scaling on your current Ether%, dealing 30 damage when at full Ether.

Can proc from criticals with the M1 tag.

talents.description: When your mantras expected=Mantras are parried, receive less posture (scales with intelligence).

talents.description: Anytime you proc Behind You, steal ether from your opponent too.

talents.name: Exotherm Path: Sanguine Blaze

talents.name: Exoskeleton
talents.description: You have a layer of fortified Natural Armor that replenishes when you rest. Your Natural Armor will resist 10% Physical Damage when active.

info.text: Exoskeleton's resistance will be less effective if you do not meet its Fortitude requirement, losing 0.125% resistance for every point under 40 Fortitude, capping at 6.875% resistance with 15 Fortitude.
Exoskeleton has 315 durability at power 1, scaling up to 600 durability at power 20.
Vesperian's Chitin damage reduction stacks multiplicatively with Exoskeleton.
Having both Exoskeleton and Chitin will cause Exoskeleton's durability to take priority, with +200 flat durability added on top, leading to 800 total durability at power 20.
Natural Armor regenerates while resting at a campfire at a rate of 2.2% per 0.2s, aka 11% per second.
Natural Armors are affected by PEN, but its effectiveness is reduced by 75%. (i.e. if someone has 100% PEN, your Natural Armor will resist 7.5% of their damage instead of nothing.)
Natural Armor will lose durability if you get hit by any attack, even if it doesn't resist it.
Natural Armor loss is based on scaled damage received and cannot normally be increased, but can be decreased by having damage reduction.

talents.name: Sclerosteosis
talents.description: Anytime you lose 10% of your health in one hit, reduce the next instance of damage you take by 99%. [5 sec CD]

info.text: You need to lose 10% of your health from a singular instance of damage, post mitigation, to proc this effect. Because of this, using the Viscosity Enchantment will result in this Talent never proccing.
The damage resistance can only proc when taking damage from weapon attacks or Mantras.

This Talent is significantly less effective against multi-hits, as the damage from each hit likely won't deal 10% of your maximum health, and the damage resistance will only affect the first instance of damage anyways.

While removing other sources of damage resistance would increase the likelihood of this effect proccing, it is not guaranteed nor recommended, as most attacks don't deal enough damage to pass the 10% maximum health threshold to begin with. In a similar vain, although self damage can be used to proc this Talent, it is not recommended to intentionally take self damage to trigger this effect.

talents.name: After Cut
talents.description: If an attack is physical and wind it will apply an after cut that does 5% of the damage you dealt. If an attack was a mantra expected=Mantra, it does 2.5% damage instead.

info.text: The only Galebreathe Mantras that benefit from the 2.5% damage increase are: Wind Blade, Air Force, Tornado Kick, Tornado, Galetrap, and Wind Gun.
The Maestro's Blade status effect from Inhale allows your basic attacks to benefit from After Cut. Galebreathe weapons benefit from After Cut without needing Inhale, however.
After Cut is not a damage modifier, it's a second hit of Galebreathe damage with no hitstun. This means it is unaffected by the damage modifier cap.
After Cut deals damage based on your final damage dealt, after resistances and multipliers.

For example, if you deal 100 M1 damage, you'll deal 10 After Cut damage, but if your opponent has 50% physical damage reduction, meaning your M1 now deals 50 damage, this'll also lower your After Cut damage to 5 (10% of 50). On the other hand, if you deal 100 M1 damage and have +50% damage from damage modifiers, After Cut will deal damage based on your modified damage, dealing 15 damage (10% of 150).

talents.name: Armor Piercing
talents.description: Your gun attacks now ignore 10% of an opponent's blunt armor. Applied Multiplicatively before PEN is applied.

info.text: This applies to the weapon attacks from all Pistol and Rifle weapons.

Mathematically speaking, Armor Piercing is effectively a multiplicative 10% increase to your PEN against blunt armor, applied after all other PEN sources, meaning Armor Piercing has heavy diminishing returns based on how much PEN you have.
Though, keep in mind that the game does not treat this effect as PEN under any circumstance, meaning PEN resistance has no effect on it.

While at 0% PEN, this effectively grants +10% PEN against blunt armor, but this amount gets reduced by 1% for every 10% PEN you have. The formula is as follows: 1 - ((1 - Current PEN%) × (1 - 10%)) = effective PEN against blunt armor.
For example: having 20% PEN + Armor Piercing is equivalent to having 28% PEN against blunt armor (+8).
Specific rifles benefit less from Armor Piercing than others due to their damage typings.
For Rifle Spear, this will only proc on critical, due to Rifle Spear being a slash based weapon.
For Stormseye and Rosen's Hellflame, they will only circumstantially benefit from Armor Piercing, because of their elemental damage.

In some circumstances, Armor Piercing may give your opponent higher weighting on their elemental resistances by lowering their blunt resistance, causing them to resist your damage based on their elemental resistance instead. Alternatively, if they have higher elemental resistance than blunt resistance, Armor Piercing will do nothing at all.
Despite being obtainable on Greatcannons, this Talent does not function on this weapon type.

Note: If you side with Asius, adding Bulletproof to your Talent pool, then pay Trig 2,000 Notes as an apology, it will add r=rare to your Talent pool as well, allowing you to obtain both Bulletproof and Armor Piercing. This is not possible if you sided with Trig initially.

talents.name: All Above, Gods Below
talents.description: Any healing your opponent were to receive while All The Dead Gods is active on them is stolen and given to you, increase your PvE Heal Boost to 15% as well.

As Anti-Heal stacks decay, the additional duration they apply to future stacks is nullified. For example, if you apply Stack 1 for 8 seconds and Stack 2 for 9 seconds, then wait until Stack 1 runs out of duration before landing another hit, Anti-Heal from the third hit will only last 9 seconds.
