talents.description: Bodies that you burn to death immediately explode, dealing massive damage. Your fires will incinerate unconscious targets much faster.

info.text: The amount of time it takes to incinerate unconscious targets is halved, from 7 to 3.5 seconds.
The time it takes for burn to execute is very reliant on server performance, it may take longer than what is listed here.
The explosion does not work; you'll burn them to death without an explosion.

talents.name: Pleeksty's Faith
talents.description: When on fire, automatically quench flames at the cost of some ether.

info.text: Costs 20 Ether.
Does not proc on self-inflicted flames.
Is also a requirement to fight Aska in Firfire. Without either this Talent, Pleeksty's Will, or the Flame Worshipper Armor you will wipe through his flames.

talents.name: Ad Astra
talents.description: Return Home

info.text: Grants a Talent tool that teleports you to The Floating Keep on use.
Using it while inside of the Floating Keep will take you back to where you initially used it.

talents.name: Chitin
talents.description: You have a layer of Natural Armor that replenishes when you rest.

info.text: Grants 5% damage reduction in the form of Natural Armor.
Chitin has 215 durability at power 1, scaling up to 500 durability at power 20.
Chitin's damage reduction stacks multiplicatively with the Exoskeleton Talent, granting 14.5% damage reduction assuming you have at least 40 Fortitude.
Having both Exoskeleton and Chitin will cause Exoskeleton's durability to take priority, with +200 flat durability added on top, leading to 800 total durability at power 20.
See r=rare for more info on Natural Armor.

talents.name: Deepfolk
talents.description: The secrets of the Deep are easier for you to unravel. Your mind is sturdier against its effects, as well as using less Knowledge in Knowledge exchanges.

info.text: Grants a 1.2x Sanity gain multiplier, affecting all sources of maximum Sanity increases.
Deep Shrine deals cost 1 less Knowledge (minimum 1).

talents.name: Echolocator
talents.description: Your highly tuned hearing helps you navigate, seeing better in the dark and sensing potential threats.

info.text: Visually pings the current location of nearby players who unsheathe their weapons (even through Tacet and Lowstride) and event spawns. This ignores walls and other obstructions.
There is a slightly delayed second ping after the initial one. Using this, you are able to gauge the speed at which the pinged players are moving.
The range at which something can be pinged is very large.
Slightly increases the visibility in dark areas.

talents.name: Feathered Glider
talents.description: As a show of independence when they come of age, Tirans will strike out on their own with just their hand-crated glider, gliding down from the mountain peaks where they make their homes. You take 10% less fall damage.

info.text: Tiran gains a Feathered Glider, a more altitide-efficient glider with infinite durability. The altitude efficiency can be further improved with the r=rare Talent.
The glider changes color depending on the Aspect variant, and can be dyed.

When using the Glider hotkey, the basic and Sharkscale Gliders will usually take priority over the Feathered Glider. You must use all of the durability in your other Gliders if you want to deploy the Feathered Glider with the hotkey.

talents.name: Loyalty
talents.description: Your bond with your allies is strong enough to reduce damage between you.

info.text: Allies take 35% less damage from you and deal 35% less damage to you. This can stack with the Give and Take Talent, totaling to 48% damage reduction.
This does not apply to self damage.

talents.name: Mark of Jurik
talents.description: Mark of Jurik, the Moonseye. A beacon of calm, those in your presence are resistant to insanity.

info.text: Gain a tool that grants sanity regeneration to nearby players. Also buffs effected players' HP regen and slightly buffs their food & thirst replenishment from consuming food and their blood regen.
4 minute cooldown.
These buffs last 1 minute, the HP regen is 15% of their total HP over that one minute period, healing 0.25% HP per second.
Also buffs non allies. Does not require you to be resting at a campfire.

talents.name: Mark of Ku
talents.description: Mark of Ku, the Mother. Improves the rest of those in your presence.

info.text: Gain a tool that buffs the blood regen of nearby players. Also buffs the effected players' HP regen and slightly buffs their food & thirst replenishment from consuming food and gives them slight sanity regen.
3 minute 30 second cooldown.
These buffs last 1 minute, the HP regen is 15% of their total HP over that one minute period, healing 0.25% HP per second.
Also buffs non allies. Can only be used while you are resting on a campfire.

talents.name: Mark of Nemit
talents.description: Mark of Nemit, the First Beast. Food consumed in your presence is more nourishing.

info.text: Gain a tool that buffs the food and thirst replenishment of nearby players. Also buffs the effected players' HP regen and slightly buffs their blood regen and gives them slight sanity regen.
3 minute 30 second cooldown.
These buffs last 1 minute, the HP regen is 15% of their total HP over that one minute period, healing 0.25% HP per second.
Also buffs non allies. Can only be used while you are resting on a campfire.

talents.name: Maudet
talents.description: Your understanding of your destiny is such that learning new things often comes naturally to you. People appreciate your diplomatic ways of speaking.

info.text: Passively obtain the benefits of the Autodidact Boon, gaining 3 Free Training Attribute points to spend every level. This effect stacks with the Boon in question.
Increases reputation gain with factions and your starting reputation with all factions.

talents.name: Molt
talents.description: Ailments and blessings alike fade away more quickly.

info.text: Chilled, Potion effects, and Suffocation have a shorter duration.
This does not work on any other status effects.

talents.name: Mothwing Dust
talents.description: You release Mothwing Dust when others are the first to strike, granting you vision of your attacker. Your antennae improve your peripheral senses, narrowing the angle at which you can be backstabbed.

info.text: When you are hit at the start of combat, the player who hit you will be highlighted with a translucent red outline. This effect lasts 10 seconds.
The angle at which you can be backhit, triggering "on backhit" effects, is reduced heavily.

talents.name: Navae's Guidance
talents.description: Navae's star guides your path, showing you the way forward. Right-clicking on maps sets a Waymarker which can be followed. You are less prone to starvation.

info.text: Receive a compass, displayed at the top of your screen, which points East.

Right clicking on the map will place a waypoint both in the physical world and on the map itself. If you already have a waypoint placed, right clicking on the map will change its location instead of placing a new one.
Reduces the passive hunger loss.
If you have the Blind Flaw, gain an area of vision around your character.

talents.name: Nightchild
talents.description: Relying on your instincts, you are naturally more stealthy. You are more nimble on wooden surfaces.

info.text: Start with 20% more stealth and gain a 1.2x stealth gain multiplier.
This Stealth gain multiplier does not apply to Stealth gained from Crouching, Lowstride, Tacet, r=faction, or the 20% Stealth from Felinor itself.
This Stealth multiplier affects the Obvious Flaw's -20% Stealth and Sly Boon's +15% Stealth, with the former reducing your starting Stealth by -24.
Gain bonus climb height when climbing on all kind of surfaces, not only wooden ones.

talents.name: Seaborne
talents.description: You have a keen understanding of ships and their maintenance.

info.text: Ships cost 20% less Notes to construct and repair, turn 20% faster, and have 10% more health.

talents.name: Teachings of the Edenkite
talents.description: Find your centre.

info.text: Allows you to meditate, emitting a white aura and causing two white orbs to circle your head.
Very heavily reduces your hunger and thirst consumption while you passively gain General EXP, Attribute EXP, and regenerate health at a mediocre rate, which is slightly reduced when in combat.

talents.name: Versatile
talents.description: You learn how to use new pieces of equipment quicker than others. You can equip things at 3 points lower than the requirement.

info.text: This works for both Equipment and Weapon item requirements, but does not work for Power requirements on items.
Also reduces the attribute requirement for alloying items.

Versatile lowers all requirements on things with more than one, so a 72 Galebreathe 37 Medium Weapon Curved Blade of Winds would be possible on a Khan for example. Additionally, Versatile stacks with Silentheart's Weapon stat requirement reduction.

The base damage reduction from not meeting your Weapon's requirements accounts for Versatile, being more lenient to Khans, and not applying if you are within 3 investment points of your weapon's normal requirements.

talents.name: Backstabber
talents.description: Landing a backhit with a light attack causes you to grab your opponent and stab them again, dealing an extra 15 damage. [15 second CD]

info.text: While standing behind an enemy, raise your weapon upwards in reverse grip. On M1, strike downwards with a 10% swing speed buff and stab the target, then leap off of them.
This deals 20 damage, not 15.
There is a per-target cooldown of 3 seconds on top of the 15s cooldown.
Procs on M1s, Silentheart abilities, and criticals with the M1 tag.
This Talent does not have a range limit.
Applies daze and ragdolls.

requirements.raw: 30 Agility, Inquisition Division, Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

talents.name: Executioner's Frenzy
talents.description: Landing a light attack while your opponent's posture is paused reduces their assassination cooldown by 5 seconds.

info.text: The Paused Posture status effect comes from r=faction and Maiming Claws.

requirements.raw: Inquisition Division, Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

talents.name: Fatal Stealth
talents.description: You deal increased backstab damage to opponents based on how high your stealth stat currently is.

info.text: Grants +0.2% damage per 1 Stealth to attacks that hit your opponent's back as a damage modifier. This affects all damage sources that can receive damage modifiers.
Stealth that is not gained from Equipment or Outfit sources do not count towards this Talent. Stealth multipliers (Felinor, Crouching, Lowstride) also do not apply.
Strangely, the Obvious Flaw is an exception to this, reducing your backhit damage by 4%.

The following Stealth sources do not apply to this Talent's damage buff: Felinor's innate Stealth and its Stealth gain multiplier, Agility investment, the Sly Boon, Crouching, Lowstride, Murmur: Tacet, and r=faction.
This does not buff assassinations.
See the Stealth page for info on where stealth can be obtained.
The maximum Stealth you can gain from Equipment alone is 30% (+6% damage).
Notably the Inquisition Light Outfit grants 50% Stealth (+10% damage).

requirements.raw: Inquisition Division, Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

talents.name: Flanking Maneuvers
talents.description: Enemies you assassinate take more PEN from your squadmates in your party.

requirements.raw: Inquisition Division, Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

talents.name: Stature Break
talents.description: Landing a backstab of any kind disables posture for 4 seconds. [8 second CD]

info.text: This applies the Paused Posture Status effect, denying most sources of Posture restoration.
During Paused Posture, you cannot restore posture by: passive posture regen, Parrying, or the Steady Nerves Talent. All other forms of posture restoration entirely ignore this status effect.

requirements.raw: Inquisition Division, Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin

talents.name: Tacet Minimization
talents.description: Focus your Tacet even further, allowing the radius at which you get spotted to become smaller temporarily.

info.text: Grants a tool that decreases your Tacet bubble size to the minimum possible and grants 400% flat Stealth for 10 seconds. 1 minute cooldown.
Requires maximum Ether to use, even though it does not consume Ether.

requirements.raw:
Murmur: Tacet, Inquisition Division, Promotion reward from the Authority Ensign Origin
**Tacet gained by obtaining Soulbreaker does not count for this Talent's obtainment.

talents.name: Critical Engine
talents.description: You gain the ability to use Deep Gems on your critical attack. Hold out the Deep Gem you wish to apply to your crit then use the tool to enhance your critical.

info.text: Equip the Deep Gem by holding the item and clicking, similar to how you would equip a Deep Gem to a Mantra.
Equipping a Deep Gem to your critical will not consume the Deep Gem.
Attempting to equip another Deep Gem to your critical attack will cause the old one to be overridden by the new one.
Proccing this Talent will put the respective Deep Gem on cooldown if it has one.
Mantle of Enmity can proc Critical Engine. If you use a Blessed Gem, your Mantle aerial attack will halve your critical cooldown rather than your Mantle's.
The fb=Brain applies to all of the below effects.
Aegis Gem grants you 10% damage reduction for 10 seconds on hit.
Blessed Gem halves your critical cooldown on hit.
Warmaster's Medallion critical cooldown reduction is applied before this effect, allowing for a 60% (55% in Chime of Conflict) reduction in critical cooldown overall.
Bloodless Gem Reduces your critical damage by 20%, but grants healing equal to 30% of the damage dealt.

Blue Gem grants you Ether back on hit. The Ether restoration is 1:1 with scaled damage dealt; it cannot be increased nor decreased through modifiers or resistances. This effect does not have PvE scaling.
Insignia Gem reduces the windup of your next Mantra cast by 15% on hit.
Kyrsan Gem applies a stacking slow on hit.
Might Gem increases the posture damage of your critical by 10%. Additionally, this can be used to proc the Ascended Outlaw Set's equipment Talents.
The posture damage bonus can be increased with the Ascended Outlaw Hat Talent, scaling on how many Might Gems you have equipped on your Mantras.
Nocturnal Gem will deal an additional 10 slash damage after a 1 second delay.
Warped Blue Gem grants the Etherguard status effect on hit if you are wearing the Bluestone Set.
Wayward Gem teleports you to your opponent after landing your critical. There is a 1 second delay between you landing your critical and teleporting.
Wind Gem gives you a speed boost for 10 seconds on hit.

Wrath Gem applies the Wrath status effect for 9 seconds, increasing your critical damage by 7.5% per player combat tag you have. This damage bonus does not apply to the hit that procced Wrath Gem and is affected by the damage modifier cap. Additionally, this can be used to proc the Reinforced War Set's equipment Talents.

talents.name: Adept Ironsinger
talents.description: You can now obtain 1-star Ironsinger mantras expected=Mantras.

info.text: This Talent will be removed from you if you no longer meet its requirements.

talents.name: Expert Ironsinger
talents.description: You can now obtain 2-star Ironsinger mantras expected=Mantras.

info.text: This Talent will be removed from you if you no longer meet its requirements.

talents.name: Heavy Shoulders
talents.description: If your opponent has 3 or more rods, their dodges are slower.

info.text: Reduces roll distance by 10%.

talents.name: Iron Veins
talents.description: You don't bleed like others do. Bleed damage reduced by 30%. Blood loss is reduced by 75%.

info.text: While at 100 Ironsing, bleed damage is reduced from 15% scaled damage to 10.5%. Bleed from Speed Demon is reduced from 7.5% scaled damage to 5.25%.
Blood loss reduction is less effective if you are using the Curse of the No Life King Enchantment.
Blood loss reduction stacks multiplicatively with Cauterized Wounds.
Iron Veins' effects scale linearly with Ironsing investment up to its requirement, losing 0.3% bleed damage reduction and 0.75% blood loss reduction per point in Ironsing below 100.
Makes your blood a shade of light grey when being attacked by an attack with the slash damage VFX.
Used to be called "Alloyblood".

talents.name: Ironclad Punishment
talents.description: Your Ironsing mantras expected=Mantras deal more posture damage to enemies the more armor durability they have.

info.text: Gain +0.15% posture damage on Ironsing Mantras for every 1% armor durability your opponent currently has, capping at +15% if your opponent is at maximum armor.
Has limited PvE usage because most non-humanoid monsters cannot block.

talents.name: Ironsinger
talents.description: Grants you the ability to command Metal as an Ironsinger. Press X to Pull on Metal Rods.

info.text: Ironsing Mantras apply stacks of Metal Rods on targets. Pressing X will pull affected towards you, with the strength of the pull depending on the amount of Metal Rods present.
You cannot apply more than 5 Metal Rods to one target, unless you have the r=rare or r=rare Talents.
Rod pull's keybind can be configured in settings.

talents.name: Laced Traps
talents.description: People hit by your 'Caltrops' are slowed and Grounded for a small duration, while also applying Sluggish to PvE enemies for a few seconds.

info.text: Landing a Caltrop slows down your opponent and disables their ability to jump for 1.1 seconds. This effect refreshes if the victim gets hit by another Caltrop.
Your Caltrops gain a purple VFX after obtaining this Talent.
The Sluggish status effect applies a -15% damage debuff to affected targets.

talents.name: Master Ironsinger
talents.description: You can now obtain 3-star Ironsinger mantras expected=Mantras.

info.text: This Talent will be removed from you if you no longer meet its requirements.

talents.name: Metal Shackles
talents.description: Guardbreaking an opponent prevents them from receiving speed boost for 5 seconds, while PvE opponents will be Sluggish for 12 seconds.

info.text: Metal shackles will visually appear on the targets legs on proc.
The Sluggish status effect applies a -15% damage debuff to affected targets.

talents.name: Oh The Irony
talents.description: Opponents affected by 'Taunt' receive double iron rods for the duration.

info.text: Affects all sources of rod application.
Any source of the Taunt status effect will work, not exclusively the Mantra itself.

talents.name: Piercing Metal
talents.description: Deal additional armor damage to enemies per metal rod affecting them.

info.text: Increases armor damage dealt by 5% per rod applied, up to 25% at 5 rods or 50% at 10.
Works amazingly in PVE, since staggering mobs is tied to breaking their armor.
Does not affect armor drain effects such as Metal.

talents.name: Thornmail
talents.description: Getting flourished applies a metal rod on your attacker.

talents.name: Grand Skewer
talents.description: Your Grand Javelin now carries opponents through the air.

info.text: Press parry during Grand Javelin's windup to activate this effect.
Does not work in Guild Bases or in Layer 1 of The Depths.

talents.name: Acceleration Points
talents.description: Striking an opponent in the back with mobility mantras expected=Mantras or Basic Attacks now steals and grants additional momentum.

info.text: Any Mantra equipped in Mobility Slots can activate this effect.

requirements.raw: Oath: Jetstriker, speak to Alirian after collecting X Jetstriker Orbs OR pay 10 to Alirian to skip Jetstriker's progression entirely (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath at least once)

talents.name: Decisive Winds
talents.description: When damage below 50% health, don an aura of Decisive Winds for 10s.

info.text: Decisive Winds grants a 25% speed boost as long as you are within 20 studs the target who initiated this effect.
30 second cooldown.
Procs through block/parry/dodge, despite the description stating otherwise. But it does not proc on self damage.
Opposite to the description, Decisive Wind's has no "aura", there is no SFX or VFX, with the only activation cue for this talent being the Cooldown Indicator.

requirements.raw: Oath: Jetstriker, speak to Alirian after collecting X Jetstriker Orbs OR pay 10 to Alirian to skip Jetstriker's progression entirely (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath at least once)

talents.name: Jetstream Pursuit
talents.description: Upon a successful flourish, teleport to the opponent when they stop moving. Receive a significant boost of momentum.

info.text: When proccing on non-humanoid NPCs, sends you to the center of the NPC's hitbox.

requirements.raw: Oath: Jetstriker, speak to Alirian after collecting X Jetstriker Orbs OR pay 10 to Alirian to skip Jetstriker's progression entirely (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath at least once)

talents.name: Oath: Jetstriker
talents.description: You vow to flow with the Song itself, drifting across where the trails may take you. If the Song permeates everything, then let it be your conduit, and you its master.

info.text: For more information, view Oath: Jetstriker.

talents.stats: +1 Mobility Mantra Slot, +1 Wildcard Mantra Slot, +5% PEN

requirements.raw: 50 Agility, beat Alirian in a race

talents.name: Rush of Ancients
talents.description: Dashing at maximum sprint momentum makes you one with the wind itself.

info.text: Extends your dash distance and makes you invisible for a very brief duration when you dash.
Has an 8 second cooldown while in combat.

requirements.raw: Oath: Jetstriker, speak to Alirian after collecting X Jetstriker Orbs OR pay 10 to Alirian to skip Jetstriker's progression entirely (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath at least once)

talents.name: Stratos Step
talents.description: Holding space while climbing will now let your perform Stratos Steps to get even higher.

info.text: Stratos Steps will only proc twice before going on a cooldown. Said cooldown applies to individual steps. Additionally, Stratos Step consumes Ether per step.

requirements.raw: Oath: Jetstriker, speak to Alirian after collecting X Jetstriker Orbs OR pay 10 to Alirian to skip Jetstriker's progression entirely (requires you to have fully progressed the Oath at least once)

talents.name: Amplified Rage
talents.description: Amped now grants you an additional +10% weapon damage. Also self-damage and cooldown by 3x.

info.text: Increases Amped's weapon damage buff from +10% to +20%.
The final sentence in this Talent's description is lying; it does not increase Electrify's cooldown, nor its self damage.
Formerly Known as Raging Static.

talents.name: Amplified Reflexes
talents.description: Amped now grants enhanced speed and parkour.

info.text: During the effects of Amped, this increases walk speed by 50%, grants an incredibly slight sprint speed increase, and grants a 20% buff to climb height. All other forms of parkour and movement are unaffected by Amplified Reflexes.
Formerly known as Jumpstart.

talents.name: Electrify
talents.description: Shock yourself and apply Amped for 15s. Can be used while Carried to escape.

info.text: Not to be confused with the unrelated Electrified status effect from the Authority Interrogator Talent category.
Electrify has a 1 minute cooldown.
Amped grants your weapon attacks a 10% damage buff and allows them to apply Shock or Surge Rods on hit.
While Amped, you take 10% more damage from all sources.
If used while Carried, it deals damage to the player who is carrying you, forcing them to drop you.
If used without being Carried, it deals 5% of your current health as Thundercall self damage, with hitstun, and applies Shock/Surge Rods to yourself on cast.

The Deepscorn Casque or Thundercall/general damage resistance can be used to mitigate the self damage. The Stormchanter's Raiments will remove the self damage and self Shock-Surge rod altogether. Wearing both the Deepscorn Casque and Stormchanter's Raiments will cause you to heal 12 flat health on cast.
Formerly known as Static Withdraw.

talents.name: Flying Swiftkick
talents.description: Hitting a Jus Karita critical attack while Swiftkick Prodigy is active will greatly slow your enemy, and consume your speed boost.

talents.name: Jus Karita
talents.description: Adopt the kick-based fighting style of the Justicars.

info.text: Allows you to use the Jus Karita fist style.

requirements.raw: Achieve a Power level of 5 and a Light Weapons attribute of 40, talk with Polis OR Justicar Origin OR chosen in Character Creation

talents.name: Justicar's Prowess
talents.description: Jus Karita gains +30% posture damage against other fist styles.

info.text: Gain +30% posture damage on weapon attacks against opponents using Way of Navae, Fang and Coil, Imperium Kata, Untrained Fist, or Legion Kata.

talents.name: Justicar's Renewal
talents.description: Hitting an opponent with your Jus Karita critical resets the cooldown.

info.text: Whenever you land the critical of Jus Karita, you can immediately use it again with no delay.
This is hard coded to only work on the default Jus Karita critical and the Vanguard critical from the Justicar Origin.
10 second cooldown.
Despite the description stating "hitting", this effect also procs on block, parry, and dodge.

talents.name: Swiftkick Prodigy
talents.description: Hitting successive Basic Attacks with Jus Karita will give a temporary speed boost.

info.text: Hitting your opponent with the M1s 3 times will grant you a speed boost.

talents.name: Kickstart
talents.description: Play the resurrector. Use your lightning to defibrillate your allies on the battlefield.

info.text: Use kickstart on an Unconscious target to bring them back up and heal them for 10% of their maximum health.
On use, this takes 5% of your Ether, draining an additional 20% on successful use.
Kickstart's animation takes 3 seconds to complete, during which, you cannot perform any actions.
Kickstart has a 10 second cooldown.
Despite the description stating "allies", this can be used on non-allies and even humanoid NPCs.
Can be used on people who are Paralyzed from Cap Artist or Paralytic Dust.

talents.name: Blade's Edge
talents.description: Damage dealt with the tip of the spear is increased by 10%.

info.text: This buff is applied if your spear attack hits someone at the very end of your weapon's range, recommending a zoning playstyle.

talents.name: Defensive Sweep
talents.description: Posture breaking an opponent grants you +50% PEN for 3 seconds.

info.text: The PEN buff only applies to M1s.
14 second cooldown.

talents.name: Driving Impact
talents.description: The first hit of your Spear's Critical Attack will deal greatly increased posture damage. Subsequent hits will do reduced posture damage.

info.text: This only works on the default spear critical.

Doubles the posture damage of the first hit of your spear critical at the cost of nullifying the posture damage from the second. This essentially consolidates the posture damage of the critical to the first hit.

talents.name: Hoplite
talents.description: Posture damage is reduced by 15% when wielding a spear and standing still.

info.text: Reduces posture damage taken, not dealt.

talents.name: Lancer's Impale
talents.description: Hitting an enemy after a perfect dodge makes your next attack deal bleed damage. If that attack would already bleed, it adds +10% chip damage instead.

talents.name: Empowered Eruption
talents.description: Your next Eruption after landing a critical is Empowered with +50% range and damage.

info.text: The Empowered Eruption buff has an indefinite duration, only being consumed when you proc an Eruption.
10 second cooldown.

talents.name: Eruption Path: Lava Serpent
talents.description: Your fire abilities no longer proc burn and instead proc an eruption under the enemies feet.

info.text: Instead of setting your target on fire when landing abilities that apply Burn, create an eruption after a 1.25 second delay, with a 3 second cooldown. Eruption damage scales with your Flamecharm investment.
Eruptions have 15 base Flamecharm damage with 5 Flamecharm Scaling. Formula to calculate damage here: "15 × (1 + 0.005 × Flamecharm Investment)"
Using the Deepfire Ring reduces the eruption delay by 20%; from 1.25s to 1s.
The Azure Flames Talent changes the eruption color to blue, while increasing their size and posture damage. The lava from r=advanced is unaffected by the color change.
Despite what the Talent description says, you can still apply burn with Eruption Path.

Burn can still be applied via: Agitating Spark (though burn needs to be present beforehand), Flame Within (Self), Flash Point, Immolation, and hitting flammable terrain with Flamecharm or Thundercall Mantras. All other sources of burn application will create an eruption instead.

Because of there being so few sources of burn application with Eruption path, using Talents that require burn, especially Emperor Flame, with this path is not recommended. Though, they'll function normally if you do happen to proc them.

extra.mutual_exclusives: Exotherm Path: Sanguine Blaze, Flashboil, The Final Act, Wraith Path: Twisted Puppets

talents.name: Flash Point
talents.description: Block breaking an opponent causes your Eruptions to be Empowered for the next 10s. 45s CD. Block breaking an opponent with a Fire Mantra procs Burning.

info.text: Empowered eruptions have +50% range and damage.

talents.name: The Floor is Lava
talents.description: Your Eruptions leave lethal pools of lava beneath them. Don't fall in.

info.text: Has slight Flamecharm scaling for its damage.
Duration of the lava pools scales on your Flamecharm investment.

talents.name: Callout
talents.description: You can mark objects or enemies by pressing Z, which will mark them for all nearby allies.

info.text: Temporarily pings the location of an object or character, with this information being displayed to your allies as well.

talents.name: Spotter
talents.description: Marking enemies while in Rhythm will now indicate their health status to your allies.

info.text: Activated by using Callout (default: Z) while in Rhythm.
Disabled on players with r=advanced.

This Talent is not required for you to see the health signifiers of your opponent(s) while in Rhythm; this Talent only provides this information to your allies. This Talent is not needed if you have alternative ways to communicate this information to your allies.

requirements.raw:
Callout, Murmur: Rhythm OR Obtain Oath: Soulbreaker
**Note: This Talent does not work if you don't have Callout, you'll need Callout to use Soulbreaker's Spotter

talents.name: Observation
talents.description: Dodge frames are larger if you cancel your roll immediately.

info.text: Cancelling your roll quickly will grant dodge frames equal to the length of a regular roll. Basically giving extra 0.1s dodge frames.

talents.name: Safety Dance
talents.description: Your base dodge frames are increased by 0.05s.

info.text: You gain more invincibility frames while dodging, granting you longer immunity to damage.
Dodge IFrames increased from 0.3s to 0.35s.
Only affects full dodge rolls, not dodge cancels.

talents.name: Air Pressure

talents.name: Duelist's Lunge
talents.description: Running attacks deal increased posture damage. Upon landing your Critical, your next running attack will have increased range.

info.text: Running attacks with rapiers deal 35% more posture damage.
After landing a Critical, the next rapier running attack has +2 stud range.

talents.name: Frenzied Dance
talents.description: The more posture you currently have, the more chip and posture damage you deal.

info.text: If your current posture is 70% or higher, your posture damage is increased by 33%, and chip damage by 20%.
Does nothing if your current posture is below 70%.

talents.name: Pressure Skewer
talents.description: Flourishing an enemy causes your M1's to deal additional chip damage, blood loss and makes your hits deal 3 extra true damage until you take damage.

info.text: While active, the following buffs are applied to Rapier light attacks and criticals with the M1 tag: increases blood loss by 50%, grants +25% chip damage, and +3 true damage.

talents.name: Fast Blade
talents.description: Extend the speed boost you get from successfully parrying an attack.

info.text: Increases the effectiveness of the on-parry speed boost from 12.5% to 27.5%, and duration its from 0.5s to 1.5s.

talents.name: Lightspeed Reflexes
talents.description: When you parry an attack after feinting an attack, gain a 5s speed boost.

info.text: Grants a 60% speed boost for 5 seconds on proc. This does not stack with the innate speed boost from parrying, nor the speed boost from Fast Blade.

talents.name: Speed Emission
talents.description: Gain a 5s speed boost and apply a 3s slow to your opponent.

info.text: Grants a 30% speed boost and applies a 15% slow.
5 second cooldown.

talents.name: Fists of Navae
talents.description: Double the amount of ether you gain on successful light attacks.

info.text: Doubles the Ether gained from landed M1 attacks.

talents.name: Oath: Oathless
talents.description: You vow to never be bound to any Oath; to live your life free of restraint. If free will is an illusion, why not make it a convincing one?
talents.stats: +10 Health, +5% PEN, +3 Wildcard Mantra Slots, +20% Oath Armor, +20% Monster Armor

requirements.raw: 10 minutes of playtime on your character, Talk to Cerulean in the cave near Miner's Landing docks

stats.stat: minutes of playtime on your character

extra.addtional info:
*See Oath: Oathless for more information.
*The Oath Armor given is treated as an armor resistance stat. This means several things:
**The Oath Armor is rendered largely ineffective against Oath attacks with multiple damage types, as the higher resistance takes priority.
**The Oath Armor is affected by PEN.
*The Monster Armor is additive to other sources of Monster Armor (i.e. Drowned).

talents.name: All Knowing
talents.description: Your prediction now ignores the range requirement to reflect attacks.

talents.name: Successive Prediction
talents.description: Predicting an attack will briefly allow you to predict another.

info.text: After landing Prediction, all subsequent hits within a very short window will also be countered.
Allows you to reflect the entirety of fast-hitting multi-hit attacks.

talents.name: Twelve Steps Ahead
talents.description: Landing Prediction will halve the cooldown to a minimum of 2s. Whiffing will double the cooldown to a maximum of 30s. This effect stacks for up to 30 seconds.

info.text: Description clarification: Landing Prediction (countering an attack successfully) will halve its current cooldown (minimum 2s), and whiffing Prediction (failing to counter an attack) will double its current cooldown (maximum 30s+). In both cases, its new cooldowns (post-land or whiff) is set as the new baseline for the next proc. Prediction's cooldown will be reset to its base cooldown if 30 seconds pass without it being used.
This effect requires your opponent to be within 90 studs of you.
For every point of Intelligence below 80, Prediction's maximum cooldown will be increased by 0.125 seconds, capping at 33.125 seconds with 55 Intelligence.

talents.name: Arachnid Surge
talents.description: Gives you a brief window of very powerful climbing, at the cost of wearing out your ankles.

info.text: Grants a Talent tool that massively increases climb height for a few seconds on use. Once this effect ends, you will be briefly unable to move.

talents.name: Bane
talents.description: Activate to make your light attacks teleport to the closest enemy nearby. [100s CD]

info.text: Grants a Talent tool that on use allows you to teleport to your opponent every time you M1 for 20 seconds.
The teleportation has a range limit of 25 studs.
Bane additionally grants a Speed Boost for its full duration.

talents.equipment: Familiar Assassin's Armor & Hidden Knife Armor

talents.name: Battle-Hardened
talents.description: Reduce how much damage you take from mantra expected=Mantra guardbreaks by 20%.

talents.name: Broodlord's Scream
talents.description: Using Sing, Taunt, or Ardour Scream applies anti heal for the duration of the move.

info.text: Applies 100% Anti-Heal.
These attacks gain the sound effect from the Mudskipper Broodlord scream attack.
Also applies to your allies.

talents.name: Circuit Breaker
talents.description: Electrify no longer deals self-damage on use.

info.text: The Electrify Talent tool no longer consumes health on use.
When paired with the Deepscorn Casque Talent, Already Dead, using Electrify will cause you to heal 12 health instead.

talents.name: Demon Step
talents.description: Activate to gain brief iframes while moving forward. This requires 50 ether to activate and increases your posture by 2, then by 20% each use.

info.text: On use, lose 50 Ether to travel a short distance forwards in iframes. Additionally, 2 + 20% of your current posture will be dealt to you as self-posture damage.
1 second cooldown.

talents.name: Focused Hematoma
talents.description: Increase the amount of temporary health you receive by 15%.

talents.name: Grapple
talents.description: Aim your mouse and shoot a grapple from your metal arm to your target and pull yourself towards it. [Requires Familiar Prosthetic Arm to use]

info.text: Upon using the provided tool, grapple to your cursor location and pull yourself towards it at high speeds.
If your cursor is hovering over a player or NPC on use, pull them towards you as well, similarly to the Lord's Slice Mantra.
Performing the Tanto's critical attack while grappling to an opponent will strike them regardless of range.

talents.name: Hyperbody
talents.description: Apply a buff to your allies around you that increases your speed, defense, and regeneration. This effect becomes weaker the more allies you buff with it. [2 min CD]

info.text: Grants a Talent tool that applies buffs to yourself and allies.
Hyperbody lasts 30 seconds, but the duration is reduced by 3 seconds per person affected, including yourself.
Hyperbody has a 2 minute cooldown.
Grants a +7.5 studs/s Speed Boost, split evenly among each ally buffed.
Grants +50% passive health regeneration, split evenly among each ally buffed.
Grants a 35.5% damage reduction buff. This is increased by 20% multiplicatively for every ally buffed.
For example at one ally, this will grant +42.6% damage reduction, at two allies this will grant 51.12% damage reduction, and so on.
Hyperbody can stack if one of your allies uses it, though the total effectiveness will only be 90% of the base effectiveness.

talents.name: Lethal Dose
talents.description: The poison from your hidden blade lasts twice as long.

info.text: The duration of the poison from Hidden Blade, which increases Shaky Block, is increased from 8 seconds to 16.

talents.name: Life Leech
talents.description:
Your summons now heal you each time they deal damage.
*Has a range limit, where the summons will not provide healing if you are too far away from them.
*Eligible summons include: Parasol's Blight monsters, The Weaving Web's spider summon, Visionshaper clones (Illusory Servants, Illusory Counter, and Cheap Trick specifically), Lightning Clones, and Flame Sentinel.
*Ineligible summons include: Metal Turret, Visionshaper clones (from Mirror Illusion), You'll Need to Get Past Me Talent, and Twisted Puppets' puppets.

talents.name: Light Piercer
talents.description: While using a spear, shoot out 3 light spears that pierce through your opponent and their block. While using Familiar Prince's Armor, all passive regeneration is increased by 10%.

info.text: Grants a Talent tool that can only be used if you have a Spear equipped. On use, fire three spear projectiles forwards, dealing 10 damage each. These have 100% chip damage.
The spears will pierce through targets, continuing on their trajectory even if they land on one target.
The spears can travel up to ~160 studs before dissapating.
The regeneration boost is multiplicative with other sources of regeneration.

talents.name: Lightning Drop
talents.description: While in the air, quickly drop down and strike your opponent where you land with fierce lightning.

info.text: Grants a Talent Tool that can only be used while you are above a certain altitude off the ground.
On use, turn into a lightning bolt and crash into the ground with a shockwave, ragdolling and damaging targets hit. The damage scales on the height difference.

talents.name: Heartwing Beat
talents.description: Your heart beats a new rhythm, as your aerial attack takes on a new manifestation.

info.text: Replaces your aerial attack with a swooshing attack that applies Wither and has innate Bleed.
You cannot use Silentheart's Relentless Hunt unless this Talent is on cooldown.
Heartwing Beat has 25 base damage, and mirrors the scaling stat from your equipped weapon. Tangentially, this Talent uses the weapon scaling formula.
For example, using Heartwing Beat on the Sword will give it 2.5 Medium scaling, while using it on the Repeater will give it 15 Light Weapon scaling.
Heartwing Beat has a 10 second cooldown.

talents.name: Herbivore
talents.description: You gain more nutrition from eating plants.

talents.name: Christmas Miracle
talents.description: Christmas Mod Shop reward. Regens hunger and thirst. "Thank you so much K1!" Heh, no problem guys. All in a day's work.

talents.name: Justicar Whistle
talents.description: Request aid from a Justicar.

info.text: On use, this opens a menu, allowing to to call for aid. Once used, Justicar players will be able to use the Justicar's Call tool to answer your call, teleporting into your server.
Justicar players will be heavily enouraged to assist you with Events and fending off Voidwalker players.
The Whistle will not work for Lone Warrior or Deepbound players if they are over level 16.

requirements.raw: Castaway, Lone Warrior, or Deepbound Origins

talents.name: Benefactor
talents.description: Gain reputation for selling goods to Antiquarians within faction territories.

info.text: Grants faction reputation when selling items to their respective Antiquarian.
Selling 100 notes worth of items gives 1 reputation, this means it would take 30000 notes worth of items to go from neutral (0) to hero (300)

talents.name: Justicar's Gift
talents.description: Your Justicar support mantras now heal your allies for 10 health instead of 5. Increase the duration of your Alsin's Aid to 15 seconds.
